text: Suraton ke shuru mein jo Huroof-e-Muqatta'at aate hain unki poori tashreeh Surah Baqarah ki tafsir ke shuru mein likh aaye hain. Aur yeh bhi hum keh aaye hain ki jis surat ke awwal mein yeh huruf aaye hain wahan umuman yehi bayan hota hai ki Quran Kalamullah hai ismein koi shak-o-shubha nahin. Chunacha yahan bhi in huruf ke baad farmaya yeh Kitab ki yaani Quran ki aayatein hain. Baaz ne kaha murad Kitab se Taurat-o-Injeel hai lekin yeh theek nahin. Phir usi par atf daal kar aur sifat is pak Kitab ki bayan farmayin ki yeh sarasar haq hai aur Allah ki taraf se tujh par utara gaya hai. Al-Haq khabar hai iska mubtada pehle bayan hua hai yaani Allazi unzila ilaika lekin Ibn Jareer ؒ ka pasandeeda qaul laye hain. Phir farmaya ki bawajood haq hone ke phir bhi aksar log iman se mehroom hain isse pehle guzra hai ki go tu hirs kare lekin aksar log iman qubool karne wale nahin. Yaani iski haqaniyat wazeh hai lekin unki zid, hatdharmi aur sarkashi unhein iman ki taraf mutawajja na hone degi.

Kamaal-e-qudrat aur azmat-e-saltanat-e-Rabbani dekho ke baghair sutonon ke aasman ko us ne buland-baala aur qayam kar rakha hai. Zameen se aasman ko Allah ne kaisa ooncha kiya aur sirf apne hukm se ise thahraya, jis ki inteha koi nahi pata. Aasman-e-duniya saari zameen ko aur jo is ke ird-gird hai paani, hawa waghera sab ko ihata kiye hue hai aur har taraf se barabar ooncha hai, zameen se paanch sau saal ki raah par hai, har jagah se itna hi ooncha hai. Phir is ki apni motaai aur dil bhi paanch sau saal ke faasle ka hai, phir doosra aasman is aasman ko bhi ghere hue hai aur pehle se doosre tak ka faasla wahi paanch sau saal ka hai. Isi tarah teesra phir choutha phir paanchwaan phir chhatta phir saatwaan jaise farmaan-e-Ilahi hai: Ayat (Allahul-lazii khalaqa sab'a samawatin wa minal-ardi mislahunna) (Surah At-Talaq: 12) yaani Allah ne saat aasman paida kiye hain aur usi ke misl zameen. Hadith-e-shareef mein hai saaton aasman aur un mein aur un ke darmiyaan mein jo kuch hai woh kursi ke muqable mein aisa hai jaise ke chatil maidan mein koi halqa ho aur kursi arsh ke muqable par bhi aisi hi hai. Arsh ki qadar Allah Azzawajal ke siva kisi ko maloom nahi. Baaz salaf ka bayaan hai ke arsh se zameen tak ka faasla pachaas hazaar saal ka hai. Arsh surkh yaqoot ka hai. Baaz mufassir kehte hain aasman ke suton to hain lekin dekhe nahi jaate. Lekin Iyas bin Muawiyah farmate hain aasman zameen par misl qasbe ke hai yaani baghair suton ke hai. Quran ke tarz-e-ibaarat ke layaq bhi yahi baat hai aur ayat (Wa yumsikus-samaa'a an taqa'a 'alal-ard) se bhi zahir hai pas "tarunaha" is nafi ki taakeed hogi yaani aasman bila suton is qadr buland hai aur tum aap dekh rahe ho, yeh hai kamaal-e-qudrat. Umayyah bin Abi Al-Salt ke ashaar mein hai, jis ke ashaar ki baabat hadith mein hai ke us ke ashaar iman laaye hain aur uska dil kufr karta hai aur yeh bhi riwayat hai ke yeh ashaar Hazrat Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail R.A ke hain jin mein hai: Wa antal-lazi min fadlihi wa rahmatihi ba'alta ila Mosa rasoolan munadiya, Fa qulta lahu fazhab wa Haroona fad'uwa ilal-laha Fir'aunal-lazi kana taghiya, Wa qula lahu hal anta sawwaita hazihi bila 'amadin wasooqu zalika baniya, Wa q

Aur yeh bayan kar diya gaya hai ke jis tarah hai usi tarah chhor di jaye. Kaifiyat, tashbih, ta'teel, tamseel se Allah ki zaat paak hai aur bartar-o-bala hai. Suraj chand us ke hukm ke mutabiq gardish mein hain aur waqt-e-mozu yani Qiyamat tak barabar usi tarah lage rahenge. Jaise farman hai ke suraj apni jagah barabar chal raha hai, us ki jagah se murad Arsh ke niche hai jo zamin ke tale se dusri taraf se mulhaq hai, yeh aur tamam sitare yahan tak pahunch kar Arsh se aur dur ho jate hain kyunke sahih baat jis par bahut si dalelein hain, yahi hai ke woh qubbah hai mutassil alam baqi asmanon ki tarah, woh muheet nahi is liye ke us ke paye hain aur us ke uthane wale hain aur yeh baat asman-e-mustadeer ghumaye hue asman mein tasawwur mein nahi aa sakti, jo bhi ghor karega use sach manega. Ayat-o-ahadith ka janchne wala usi nateejah par pahuchega. Walillahil-hamdu wal-minnah. 

Sirf suraj chand ka hi zikr yahan is liye hai ke saton siyaroon mein bare aur roshan yahi do hain, pas jab ke yeh dono musakhkhar hain toh aur toh batur-e-awla musakhkhar hue. Jaise ke suraj chand ko sajdah na karo se murad aur sitaron ko bhi sajdah na karna hai. Phir aur ayat mein tasreeh bhi maujud hai, farman hai: 

(Wa ash-shamsa wal-qamara wan-nujuma musakhkharatim bi-amrih, ala lahul-khalqu wal-amr, tabarakallahu Rabbul-'alamin) (7. Al-A'raf: 54)

Yaani suraj chand aur sitare us ke hukm se musakhkhar hain, wahi khalq-o-amr wala hai, wahi barkaton wala hai, wahi Rabbul-'alamin hai. Woh apni ayton ko, apni wahdaniyat ki daleelon ko ba-tafseel bayan farma raha hai ke tum us ki tauheed ke qayil ho jao aur use maan lo ke woh tumhein fana kar ke phir zinda kar dega.

Alam-e-Sifli ke anwa-o-aqsam

Upar ki aayat mein Alam-e-Ulwi ka bayaan tha, yahan Ilm-e-Sifli ka zikr ho raha hai, zameen ko tul-o-arz mein phaila kar Allah hi ne bichaya hai. Is mein mazboot pahad bhi usi ke gaade hue hain, is mein daryao aur chashmo ko bhi usi ne jari kiya hai. Taki mukhtalif shakl-o-soorat, mukhtalif rang, mukhtalif zaiqo ke phal phool ke darakht is se siraab hon. Joda joda mewae us ne paida kiye, khatte mithe waghera. Raat din ek dusre ke pe dar pe barabar aate jaate rehte hain, ek ka aana dusre ka jaana hai pas makan, sukan aur zaman sab mein tasarruf usi Qadir-e-Mutlaq ka hai. Allah ki in nishaniyo, hikmato, aur dalail ko jo ghor se dekhe woh hidayat yafta ho sakta hai. 

Zameen ke tukde mile jule hue hain, phir qudrat ko dekhe ke ek tukde se to paidawar ho aur dusre se kuch na ho. Ek ki mitti surkh, dusre ki safaid, zard, woh siyah, yeh pathreeli, woh narm, yeh meethi, woh shor. Ek retli, ek saaf, gharz yeh bhi Khaliq ki qudrat ki nishani hai aur batati hai ke Faail, Khud-Mukhtar, Malik-ul-Mulk, La Shareek ek wahi Allah Khaliq-ul-Kul hai. Na us ke siwa koi mabood, na palne wala. 

Zur'w-o-Nabeel ko agar jinaat par ataf dalein toh paish se marfoo padhna chahiye aur aanaab par ataf dalein toh zer se muzaf ilaih maan kar majroor padhna chahiye. Aimma ki jamaat ki dono qiratein hain. 

Sivan kehte hain ek darakht jo kai tano aur shakhon wala ho jaise anar aur anjeer aur baaz khajooriyaan. Ghair sivan jo is tarah na ho ek hi tana ho jaise aur darakht hote hain. Isi se insan ke chacha ko Sinwan-ul-Ab kehte hain, hadith mein bhi yeh aaya hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Umar ؓ se farmaya kya tumhe maloom nahi ke insan ka chacha misl baap ke hota hai. Bara ؓ farmate hain ek jad yani ek tane mein kai ek shakhdaar darakht khajoor hote hain aur ek tane par ek hi hota hai yahi sivan aur ghair sivan hai, yahi qaul aur buzrugo ka bhi hai. 

Sab ke liye pani ek hi hai yani barish ka lekin har maze aur phal mein kami beshi mein be-inteha farq hai, koi meetha hai, koi khatta hai. Hadith mein bhi yeh tafseer hai mulahiza ho Tirmidhi Sharif. 

Al-Gharz qismo aur janso ka ikhtilaf, shakl soorat ka ikhtilaf, rang ka ikhtilaf, boo ka ikhtilaf, maze ka ikhtilaf, pato ka ikhtilaf, taro-tazgi ka ikhtilaf, ek bahut hi meetha, ek sakht kadwa, ek nihayat khush zaiqa, ek behad badmaza, rang kisi ka zard, kisi ka surkh, kisi ka safaid, kisi ka siyah. Isi tarah tazgi aur phal mein bhi ikhtilaf, halanki ghiza ke aitbaar se sab yaksan hain. Yeh qudrat ki nairangiyaan ek hoshyar shakhs ke liye ibrat hain aur Faail-e-Mukhtar Allah ki qudrat ka bada zabardast pata deti hain ke jo woh chahta hai hota hai. Aqlmando ke liye yeh aayatein aur yeh nishaniyan kafi wafi hain.

Aqal ke andhe ziddi log Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala apne Nabi ﷺ se farmata hai ki aap in ke jhutlane ka koi taajjub na karein, yeh hain hi aise is qandar nishaniyan dekhte hue, Allah ki qudrat ka hamesha mutala karte hue, ise mante hue ki sab ka khaliq Allah hi hai phir bhi qiyamat ke munkir hote hain halanki is se barh kar roz-marah mushahida karte rehte hain ki kuch nahi hota aur Allah Ta'ala sab kuch kar deta hai. Har aqil jaan sakta hai ki zameen o asman ki paidaish insan ki paidaish se bahut bari hai aur dobara paida karna ba-nisbat awwal bar paida karne ke bahut asan hai. Jaise farman-e-Rabbani hai ayat: Awalam yaraw annallahal-lazi khalaqas-samawati wal-arda wa lam ya'ya bi-khalqihinna bi-qadirin ala ay yuhyal-mawta, bala innahu ala kulli shai'in qadir (46. Al-Ahqaf: 33) Yani jis ne asman o zameen thake paida kar diya, kya woh murdon ko zinda karne par qadir nahi? Beshak hai balki har cheez us ki qudrat mein hai. Pas yahan farmata hai ki asal yeh kuffar hain, in ki gardanon mein qiyamat ke din tauq honge aur yeh jahannami hain jo hamesha jahannam mein rahenge.

Munakirin-e-Qiyamat yeh munkirin-e-qiyamat kehte hain ke agar sachche ho toh hum par Allah ka azaab jald hi kyun nahi laate? Kehte the ke ae apne aap par Allah ki wahi nazil hone ka dawa karne wale, hamare nazdeek toh tu pagal hai. Agar bil-farz sacha hai toh azaab ke farishton ko kyun nahi lata? Uske jawab mein unse kaha gaya ke farishte haq ke aur faisle ke sath hi aya karte hain, jab woh waqt aayega us waqt iman lane ya tauba karne ya nek amal karne ki fursat-o-mohalat nahi milegi. Isi tarah aur ayat mein hai ayat (wa yasta'junakan do ayaton tak). Aur jagah hai saala saailun al-kh. Aur ayat mein hai ke be-iman is ki jaldi macha rahe hain aur imandar is se khauf kha rahe hain aur ise bar-haq jaan rahe hain. Isi tarah aur ayat mein farman hai ke woh kehte the ke ae Allah agar yeh teri taraf se haq hai toh hum par aasman se patthar barsa ya koi aur almanaak azaab nazil farma. Matlab yeh hai ke apne kufr-o-inkar ki wajah se Allah ke azaab ka aana muhaal jaan kar is qadar nadar aur be-khauf ho gaye the ke azaab ke utarne ki aarzu aur talab kiya karte the. Yahan farmaya ke unse pehle ke aise logon ki misalein unke samne hain ke kis tarah woh azaab ki pakar mein aa gaye. Keh do ke yeh toh Allah Ta'ala ka hilm-o-karam hai ke gunah dekhta hai aur foran nahi pakarta warna ro-e-zameen par kisi ko chalta phirta na chhode, din raat khataayein dekhta hai aur dar-guzar farmata hai lekin is se yeh na samajh liya jaye ke woh azaab par qudrat nahi rakhta. Uske azaab bhi bade khatarnak nihayat sakht aur bahut dard dukh dene wale hain. Chunacha farman hai ayat (Fa in kazzabooka faqul rabbukum zoo rahmatin wasi'atin wa la yuraddu ba'suhu anil-qaumil-mujrimin) (6. Al-An'am: 147). Agar yeh tujhe jhutlayen toh tu keh de ke tumhara rab wasi' rehmaton wala hai lekin is ke aaye hue azaab gunahgaron par se nahi hataye ja sakte. Aur farman hai ke tera parwardigar jald azaab karne wala, bakhshne wala aur mehrbani karne wala hai aur ayat mein hai ayat (Nabbi' 'ibadi anni anal-gafoor-ur-raheem) (15. Al-Hijr: 49). Mere bandon ko khabar kar de ke main ghafoor-ur-raheem hoon aur mere azaab bhi bade dardnaak hain. Isi qism ki aur bhi bahut se ayatein hain jin mein ummeed-o-beem, khauf-o-lalach ek sath bayan hua hai. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai is mein hai is ayat ke utarne par Rasoolullah ﷺ ne farmaya agar Allah Ta'ala ka maaf فرمانا (farmana) aur dar-guzar farmana na hota toh kisi ki zindagi ka lutf baaqi na rehta aur agar is ka dhamkana drana aur sam'a karna na hota toh har shakhs be-parwahi se zulm-o-ziyadati mein mashghool ho jata.

Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke Hasan bin Usman Abu Hassan raawi ؒ ne khwab mein Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal ka deedar kiya, dekha ke An-Hazrat ﷺ Allah ke samne khare apne ek ummati ki shafa'at kar rahe hain, jis par farman-e-bari hua ke kya tujhe itna kafi nahi ke maine Surah Ra'd mein tujh par ayat (WA INNA RABBAKA LAZOO MAGHFIRATIL LIN-NASI 'ALA ZULMIHIM WA INNA RABBAKA LASHADIDUL 'IQAB) (13. Al-Ra'd: 6) nazil farmai hai. Abu Hassan ؒ farmate hain iske baad meri ankh khul gayi.

I'tiraz baraye i'tiraz kafir log az-ro-e-i'tiraz kaha karte thay ke jis tarah agle paighambar mojze le kar aaye, yeh paighambar kyun nahi laye? Masalan Safa pahaar sone ka bana dete ya masalan Arab ke pahaar yahan se hat jaate aur yahan sabza aur nahrein ho jaatein. Pas un ke jawab mein aur jagah hai ke hum yeh mojze bhi dikha dete magar aglon ki tarah un ke jhutlane par phir aglon jaise hi azaab un par aa jaate. To un ki baton se maghmoom o mutafakkir na ho jaya kar, tere zimme to sirf tabligh hi hai tu hadi nahi, un ke na manne se teri pakar na hogi. Hidayat Allah ke haath hai, yeh tere bas ki baat nahi. Har kaum ke liye rahbar aur daayi hai. Ya yeh matlab hai ke hadi main hoon to tu darane wala hai. Aur aayat mein (Wa in min ummatin illa khala fiha nazirun) (Surah Fatir: 24) har ummat mein darane wala guzra hai aur murad yahan hadi se paighambar hai. Pas peshwa rahbar har giroh mein hota hai, jis ke ilm o amal se dusre raah pa sakein, is ummat ke peshwa Aan-Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ hain. Ek nihayat hi munkir waahi riwayat mein hai ke is aayat ke utarne ke waqt Aap ne apne seene par haath rakh ke farmaya munzir to main hoon aur Hazrat Ali R.A ke kandhe ki taraf ishara kar ke farmaya اے Ali tu hadi hai, mere baad hidayat paane wale tujh se hidayat payenge. Hazrat Ali R.A se manqool hai ke is jagah hadi se murad Quraish ka ek shakhs hai. Junaid kehte hain woh Hazrat Ali R.A khud hain. Ibn Jarir Rahimahullah ne Hazrat Ali R.A ke hadi hone ki riwayat ki hai lekin is mein sakht nakarat hai.

Ilm-e-Ilahi Allah ke ilm se koi cheez poshida nahi. Tamam jandar mada haivan hon ya insan, un ke pet ke bachon ka, un ke hamal ka, Allah ko ilm hai ke pet mein kya hai? Use Allah bakhubi janta hai yani mard hai ya aurat? Achha hai ya bura? Nek hai ya bad? Umar wala hai ya be-umar ka? Chunacha irshad hai ayat (Hu a'lamu bikum) Al-akh, woh bakhubi janta hai jab ke tumhein zameen se paida karta hai aur jab ke tum maan ke pet mein chhupe hue hote ho, Al-akh. Aur farman hai ayat (Yakhluqukum fi butuni ummahatikum khalqan mim ba'di khalqin fi zulumatin thalath) (39. Az-Zumar: 6), woh tumhe tumhari maan ke pet mein paida karta hai ek ke baad dusri paidaish mein teen teen andheron mein. Irshad hai ayat (Wa laqad khalaqnal insana min sulalatin) Al-akh, hum ne insan ko mitti se paida kiya, phir nutfe se, nutfe ko khoon basta kiya, khoon baste ko lothra gosht ka kiya, lothre ko haddi ki shakal mein kar diya, phir haddi ko gosht chadaya, phir aakhri aur paidaish mein paida kiya, pas behtareen khaliq babarkat hai. Bukhari o Muslim ki hadith mein farman-e-Rasool Allah ﷺ hai ke tum mein se har ek ki paidaish chaalis din tak us ki maan ke pet mein jama hoti rehti hai, phir utne hi dinon tak woh basurat-e-khoon basta rehta hai, phir utne hi dinon tak woh basurat-e-gosht ka lothra rehta hai, phir Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ek farishte ko bhejta hai, jise chaar baaton ke likh lene ka hukum hota hai, us ka rizq, umar, amal aur nek bad hona likh leta hai. Aur hadith mein hai woh puchhta hai ke 'aye Allah! Mard hoga ya aurat? Shaq hoga ya saeed? Rozi kya hai? Umar kitni hai?' Allah Ta'ala batlata hai aur woh likh leta hai. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain ghaib ki kunjiyan paanch hain jinhein bajuz Allah Ta'ala Aleem o Khabeer ke aur koi nahi janta: kal ki baat Allah ke siwa aur koi nahi janta, pet mein kya badhta hai aur kya ghatta hai koi nahi janta, barish kab barsegi is ka ilm bhi kisi ko nahi, kaun shakhs kahan marega ise bhi us ke siwa koi nahi janta, qayamat kab qaim hogi is ka ilm bhi Allah hi ko hai. Pet mein kya ghatta hai is se murad hamal ka saqit hojana hai aur raham mein kya badh raha hai, kaise pura ho raha hai, yeh bhi Allah ko bakhubi ilm rehta hai. Dekh lo koi aurat das mahine leti hai, koi nau, kisi ka hamal ghatta hai, kisi ka badhta hai, nau mah se ghatna, nau se badh jana Allah ke ilm mein hai. Hazrat Dahhak ka bayan hai ke main do saal maan ke pet mein raha, jab paida hua to mere agle do daant nikal aaye thay. Hazrat Aisha R.A ka farman hai ke hamal ki intehai muddat do saal ki hoti hai. Kami se murad baaz ke nazdeek ayyam-e-hamal mein khoon ka aana aur ziyadti se murad nau mah se ziyada hamal ka thehrah rehna hai. Mujahid R.H farmate hain nau se pehle jab aurat khoon ko dekhe to nau se ziyada hojate hain misl ayyam-e-haiz ke. Khoon ke girne se bachcha achha hojata hai aur na gire to bachcha pura patha aur bada hota hai.

Hazrat Makhool (Rahimahullah) farmate hain bacha apni maan ke pet mein bilkul begam, bekhatke aur ba-aram hota hai. Us ki maan ke haiz ka khoon us ki ghiza hota hai, jo betalab aram use pahunchta rehta hai yahi wajah hai ki maan ko un dino haiz nahi ata. Phir jab bacha paida hota hai zameen par ate hi rota chalata hai, us anjan jagah se use wehshat hoti hai, jab us ki naal kat jati hai toh Allah Ta'ala us ki rozi maan ke seene mein pahaunch deta hai aur ab bhi betalab, be-justju, be-ranj-o-gham, be-fikri ke sath use rozi milti rehti hai. Phir zara bara hota hai apne hathon khane peene lagta hai. Lekin balig hote hi rozi ke liye haye haye karne lagta hai. Maut aur qatal tak se rozi hasil hone ka imkan ho toh pas-o-pesh nahi karta. Aur farman hai ayat (Yakhluqukum fi butuni ummahatikum khalqan mim ba'di khalqin fi zulumatin thalath) (39. Az-Zumar: 6), woh tumhe tumhari maan ke pet mein paida karta hai ek ke baad dusri paidaish mein teen teen andheron mein. Bukhari o Muslim ki hadith mein farman-e-Rasool Allah ﷺ hai ke tum mein se har ek ki paidaish chaalis din tak us ki maan ke pet mein jama hoti rehti hai, phir utne hi dinon tak woh basurat-e-khoon basta rehta hai, phir utne hi dinon tak woh basurat-e-gosht ka lothra rehta hai, phir Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ek farishte ko bhejta hai, jise chaar baaton ke likh lene ka hukum hota hai, us ka rizq, umar, amal aur nek bad hona likh leta hai. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain ghaib ki kunjiyan paanch hain jinhein bajuz Allah Ta'ala Aleem o Khabeer ke aur koi nahi janta: kal ki baat Allah ke siwa aur koi nahi janta, pet mein kya badhta hai aur kya ghatta hai koi nahi janta, barish kab barsegi is ka ilm bhi kisi ko nahi, kaun shakhs kahan marega ise bhi us ke siwa koi nahi janta, qayamat kab qaim hogi is ka ilm bhi Allah hi ko hai. Pet mein kya ghatta hai is se murad hamal ka saqit hojana hai aur raham mein kya badh raha hai, kaise pura ho raha hai, yeh bhi Allah ko bakhubi ilm rehta hai. Dekh lo koi aurat das mahine leti hai, koi nau, kisi ka hamal ghatta hai, kisi ka badhta hai, nau mah se ghatna, nau se badh jana Allah ke ilm mein hai. Hazrat Dahhak ka bayan hai ke main do saal maan ke pet mein raha, jab paida hua to mere agle do daant nikal aaye thay. Hazrat Aisha R.A ka farman hai ke hamal ki intehai muddat do saal ki hoti hai. Kami se murad baaz ke nazdeek ayyam-e-hamal mein khoon ka aana aur ziyadti se murad nau mah se ziyada hamal ka thehrah rehna hai. Mujahid R.H farmate hain nau se pehle jab aurat khoon ko dekhe to nau se ziyada hojate hain misl ayyam-e-haiz ke. Khoon ke girne se bachcha achha hojata hai aur na gire to bachcha pura patha aur bada hota hai.

Woh Sami-o-Basir hai, jo apne ghar ke tehkhane mein raaton ke andhere mein chhupa huwa ho woh aur jo din ke waqt khulm khula aabad raston mein chala ja raha ho woh ilm mein barabar hain. Hud: 5) mein farmaya hai aur aayat (Wa ma takoonu fi shanin wa ma tatloo minhu min quranin wa la ta'amaloona min amalin illa kunna alaikum shuhoodan idh tufeedoona fihi) (10. Yunus: 61) mein irshad huwa hai ki tumhare kisi kaam ke waqt hum idhar udhar nahi hote, koi zarra hamari maloomat se kharij nahi. Allah ke farishte batour nigehbaan aur choukidar ke bandon ke ارد gird muqarrar hain, jo unhen aafton se aur takleefon se bachate rehte hain jaise ki aamal par nigehbaan farishton ki aur jamaat hai, jo baari baari pe dar pe aate jaate rehte hain, raat ke alag din ke alag. Pas har insan har waqt chaar farishton mein rehta hai, do katib-e-aamal daayein baayein do nigehbani karne wale aage peechhe, phir raat ke alag din ke alag. Chunancha hadith mein hai tum mein farishte pe dar pe aate jaate rehte hain, raat ke aur din ke un ka mel subh aur asr ki namaz mein hota hai raat guzarne wale aasman par chadhte hain. Bawajood ilm ke Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala un se poochhta hai ki tum ne mere bandon ko kis halat mein chhoda? Woh jawab dete hain ki hum gaye to unhen namaz mein paya aur aaye to namaz mein chhod aaye. Aur hadith mein hai tumhare sath woh hain jo siwa pakhane aur jima' ke waqt ke tum se alag nahi hote. Pas tumhen un ka lehaz, un ki sharm, un ka ikram aur un ki izzat karni chahiye. Mujahid kehte hain har bande ke saath Allah ki taraf se muwakil hai jo use sote jagte jinnaat se, insan se, zehreelay janwaron aur tamam aafaton se bachata rehta hai, har cheez ko rok deta hai magar woh jise Allah pahunchana chahe. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh duniya ke badshahoun, ameeroun waghera ka zikr hai jo pehre choki mein rehte hain. Dahhak farmate hain ke sultan Allah ki nigahbani mein hota hai Amr-e-Ilahi se yaani mushrikeen aur zahireen se. Wallahu A'lam. Mumkin hai gharz is qaul se yeh ho ke jaise badshahoun ameeroun ki choukidari sipahi karte hain usi tarah bande ke choukidar Allah ki taraf se muqarrar shuda farishte hote hain. Ek ghareeb riwayat mein Tafsir Ibn Jarir mein waarid hua hai ke Hazrat Usman (R.A) Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaye aur aap se daryaft kiya ke farmaiye bande ke saath kitne farishte hote hain? Aap ne farmaya ek to dayen jaanib nekiyon ka likhne wala jo bayen jaanib wale par ameer hai jab tu koi neki karta hai woh ek ki bajaye das likh li jaati hain jab tu koi burayi kare to bayen jaanib wala dayen wale se iske likhne ki ijazat talab karta hai woh kehta hai zara thehar jaao shayad yeh tauba-o-istighfar karle teen martaba woh ijazat mangta hai tab tak bhi agar isne tauba na ki to yeh neki ka farishta isse kehta hai ab likh le Allah humein isse bachaye yeh to bada bura sathi hai. Ise Allah ka lihaaz nahi yeh isse nahi sharmata. Allah ka farmaan hai ke insan jo baat zabaan par laata hai us par nigehbaan mutaeen aur muhayya hain. Aur do farishte tere aage peechhe hain farmaan-e-Ilahi hai: "Lahu mu'aqqibatun" al-ayah. Idhar behkane ke liye din bhar to Iblis ki duty rehti hai aur raat ko iski aulaad ki. Musnad Ahmad mein hai tum mein se har ek ke saath jinn sathi hai aur farishta sathi hai logon ne kaha aap ke saath bhi? Farmaya haan lekin Allah ne is par meri madad ki hai, woh mujhe bhulai ke siva kuch nahi kehta (Muslim). Yeh farishte bi-hukm-e-Rabb iski nigahbani rakhte hain. Aap ne farmaya: Woh khud Allah ki muqarrar karda hai.

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Bani Israel ke nabiyon mein se ek ki taraf Wahi-e-Ilahi hui ke apni kaum se keh de ke jis basti wale aur jis ghar wale Allah ki itaat guzari karte karte Allah ki masiyat karne lagte hain, Allah Ta'ala un ki rahat ki cheezon ko un se door kar ke unhein woh cheezain pahunchata hai jo unhein تکلیف (takleef) dene wali hon. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Bani Israel ke nabiyon mein se ek ki taraf Wahi-e-Ilahi hui ke apni kaum se keh de ke jis basti wale aur jis ghar wale Allah ki itaat guzari karte karte Allah ki masiyat karne lagte hain, Allah Ta'ala un ki rahat ki cheezon ko un se door kar ke unhein woh cheezain pahunchata hai jo unhein تکلیف (takleef) dene wali hon. Is ki tasdeeq Quran ki aayat (Innal-laha la yughayyiru ma biqaumin hatta yughayyiru ma bi-anfusihim, wa iza arada Allahu biqaumin su'an fala maradda lahu, wa ma lahum min dunihin min walin 13. Ar-Ra'd: 11) se bhi hoti hai.

Imam Ibn Abi Shaiba ki kitab Sifat-ul-Arsh mein yeh riwayat marfu'an bhi aayi hai. Umair bin Abdul Malik kehte hain ke Kofe ke mimbar par Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne hamein khutba sunaya jis mein farmaya ke agar main chup rehta toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) baat shuru karte aur jab main poochta toh aap mujhe jawab dete. Ek din aap ne mujh se farmaya: Allah Ta'ala farmata hai, mujhe qasam hai apni izzat-o-jalal ki, apni bulandi ki jo Arsh par hai, ke jis basti ke jis ghar ke log meri nafarmaniyon mein mubtala hon phir unhein chhod kar mere farmanbardari mein lag jayen toh main bhi apne azab aur dukh un se hata kar apni rahmat aur sukh unhein ata farmata hoon. Yeh Hadith ghareeb hai aur is ki sanad mein ek rawi ghair maroof hai.

Bijli kar garaj bijli bhi us ke hukm mein hai. Ibn Abbas R.A ne ek sail ke jawab mein kaha tha ke barq pani hai. Musafir ise dekh kar apni eza aur mashaqqat ke khauf se ghabrata hai aur muqeem barkat-o-nafa ki umeed par rizq ki ziyadasti ka lalach karta hai, wohi bojhlad baadon ko paida karta hai jo ba-wajah pani ke bojh ke zameen ke qareeb aa jate hain. Pas in mein bojh pani ka hota hai. Phir farmaya ke kadak bhi us ki tasbeeh-o-tareef karti hai. Ek aur jagah hai ke har cheez Allah ki tasbeeh-o-hamd karti hai. Ek hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala badal paida karta hai jo achhi tarah bolte hain aur hanste hain. Mumkin hai bolne se murad garajna aur hanste hain se murad bijli ka zahir hona hai. Saad bin Ibrahim kehte hain Allah Ta'ala barish bhejta hai us se achhi boli aur us se achhi hansi wala koi aur nahi. Us ki hansi bijli hai aur us ki guftugu garaj hai. Muhammad bin Muslim kehte hain ke humein yeh baat pohnchi hai ki barq ek farishta hai jis ke chaar munh hain ek insan jaisa, ek bail jaisa, ek gadhe jaisa, ek sher jaisa, woh jab dum hilata hai to bijli zahir hoti hai. An-Hazrat ﷺ garaj kadak ko sun kar yeh dua padhte, dua: (Allahumma la taqtulna bi-ghadabika wa la tuhlikna bi-'azabika wa 'afina qabla zalika) (Tirmidhi). Aur rivayat mein yeh dua hai: (Subhana man sabbaha ar-ra'du bi-hamdihi). Hazrat Ali garaj sun kar padhte: (Subhana man sabbahat lahu). Ibn Abi Zakriya farmate hain jo shakhs garaj kadak sun kar kahe, dua: (Subhanallahi wa bi-hamdihi) us par bijli nahi giregi. Abdullah bin Zubair R.A garaj kadak ki awaz sun kar baatein chhod dete aur farmate, dua: (Subhanallahillazi yusabbihu ar-ra'du bi-hamdihi wal-mala'ikatu min khifatihi) aur farmate ke is ayat mein aur is awaz mein zameen walon ke liye bahut tanzeer-o- عبرت (ibrat) hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain ke tumhara Rab-ul-Izzat farmata hai agar mere bande meri poori itaa'at karte to raton ko barishein barsata aur din ko suraj chadhata aur unhein garaj ki awaz tak na sunata. Tabarani mein hai Aap farmate hain garaj sun kar Allah ka zikr karo, kyunke zikr karne walon par kadaka nahi girta. Woh bijli bhejta hai jis par chahe us par girata hai. Isi liye aakhir zamane mein bakasrat bijliyan girenge. Musnad ki hadith mein hai ke qayamat ke qareeb bijli bakasrat giregi yahan tak ke ek shakhs apni kaum se aa kar puchega ke subah kis par bijli giri? Woh kahenge, falan falan par. Abu Yala rawi hain An-Hazrat Rasulullah ﷺ ne ek shakhs ko ek maghroor sardar ke bulane ko bheja us ne kaha kaun Rasulullah? Allah sone ka hai ya chandi ka? Ya peetal ka? Qasid wapas aya aur Huzoor ﷺ se yeh zikr kiya ke dekhiye main ne to aap se pehle hi kaha tha ke woh mutakabbir, maghroor shakhs hai. Aap ise na bulawaye. Aap ne farmaya dobara jao aur us se yahi kaho. Us ne ja kar phir bulaya lekin us maloon ne yahi jawab is martaba bhi diya.

Qasid ne wapas aa kar phir Huzoor ﷺ se arz kiya aap ne teesri martaba bheja ab ki martaba bhi us ne paigham sun kar wahi jawab dena shuru kiya ke ek badal us ke sar par aa gaya karka aur us mein se bijli giri aur us ke sar se khopڑی uṛa li gai. Is ke baad yeh ayat utri. Ek riwayat mein hai ke ek yahudi Hazrat ﷺ ke paas aaya aur kehne laga ke Allah Ta'ala tambe ka hai ya moti ka ya yaqوت ka abhi us ka sawal pura na hua tha jo bijli giri aur woh tabah ho gaya aur yeh ayat utri. Qatadah kehte hain mazkoor hai ke ek shakhs ne Quran ko jhutlaya aur Aan-e-Hazrat ﷺ ki nubuwwat se inkar kiya usi waqt aasman se bijli giri aur woh halak ho gaya aur yeh ayat utri. Is ayat ke shaan-e-nuzool mein Aamir bin Tufail aur Azbad bin Rabiah ka qissa bhi bayan hota hai. Yeh dono sardaran-e-Arab Madine mein Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaye aur kaha ke hum aap ko maan lenge lekin is shart par ke hamein aadhon aadh ka shareek kar lein. Aap ne unhein is se mayoos kar diya toh Aamir maloon ne kaha Wallah main sare Arab ke maidan ko lashkaron se bhar dunga aap ne farmaya tu jhoota hai, Allah tujhe yeh waqt hi nahi dega phir yeh dono Madine mein thahre rahe ke moqa pa kar Huzoor ﷺ ko ghaflat mein qatal kar dein chunacha ek din unhein moqa mil gaya ek ne toh aap ko samne se baaton mein laga liya doosra talwar le kar peechhe se aa gaya lekin is Hafiz-e-Haqiqi ne aap ko un ki shararat se bacha liya. Ab yahan se namurad ho kar chale aur apne jale dil ke phaphule phodne ke liye Arab ko aap ke khilaf ubharne lage isi haal mein Arbad par aasman se bijli giri aur us ka kaam toh tamam ho gaya Aamir taaun ki gulti se pakda gaya aur usi mein bilak bilak kar jaan di aur isi jaison ke bare mein yeh ayat utri ke Allah Ta'ala jis par chahe bijli girata hai. Arbad ke bhai Labid ne apne bhai ke is waqie ko ashaar mein khoob bayan kiya hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Aamir ne kaha ke agar main musalman ho jaun toh mujhe kya milega? Aap ne farmaya jo sab musalmanon ka haal wahi tera haal. Us ne kaha phir toh main musalman nahi hota. Agar aap ke baad is amr ka wali main banun toh main deen qabool karta hoon. Aap ne farmaya yeh amr-e-khilafat na tere liye hai na teri kaum ke liye haan hamara lashkar teri madad par hoga. Us ne kaha is ki mujhe zaroorat nahi ab bhi Najdi lashkar meri pusht panahi par hai mujhe toh kachche pakke ka malik kar dein toh main deen-e-Islam qabool kar lun. Aap ne farmaya nahi. Yeh dono aap ke paas se chale gaye. Aamir kehne laga Wallah main Madine ko charon taraf lashkaron se mahasoor kar lunga. Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya Allah tera yeh irada pura nahi hone dega. Ab in dono ne aapas mein mashwra kiya ke ek toh Hazrat ﷺ ko baaton mein lagaye doosra talwar se aap ka kaam tamam kar de. Phir un mein se lade ga kaun? Zyada se zyada diyat de kar peecha chhoot jaye ga. Ab yeh dono phir aap ke paas aaye. Aamir ne kaha zara aap uth kar yahan aaiye. Main aap se kuch baatein karna chahta hoon.

Aap uthe, us ke sath chale, aik deewar tale woh baatein karne laga. Huzoor ﷺ ki nazar pusht ki janib padi toh aap ne yeh halat dekhi aur wahan se laut kar chale aaye. Ab yeh dono Madine se chale Harra-e-Raqim mein aa kar thahre lekin Hadhrat Sa'd bin Mu'az aur Usaid bin Hudair R.A wahan pahuche aur unhein wahan se nikala, Raqim mein pahuche hi thay ke Arbad par bijli giri, us ka toh wahin dhair ho gaya. Aamir yahan se bhag chala lekin Darih mein pahucha tha ke use ta'oon ki gulti nikli. Banu Salol qabile ki aik aurat ke haan yeh thahra. Woh kabhi kabhi apni gardan ki gulti ko dabata aur taajjub se kehta yeh toh aisi hai jaise oont ki gulti hoti hai, afsos main Saloliyah aurat ke ghar par maroon ga. Kya acha hota ke main apne ghar hota. Aakhir is se na raha gaya, ghoda mangwaya, sawar huwa aur chal diya lekin raste hi mein halak ho gaya, pas un ke bare mein yeh aayatein (Allah ya'lam se man wal tak) nazil huin. Un mein An-Hazrat ﷺ ki hifazat ka zikr bhi hai phir Arbad par bijli girne ka zikr hai aur farmaya hai ke yeh Allah ke bare mein jhagadte hain. Us ki azmat-o-tauheed ko nahi mante. Halanki Allah Ta'ala apne mukhalifon aur munkiron ko sakht saza aur na-qabil-e-bardasht azab karne wala hai. Pas yeh aayat misl aayat (Wa makaru makran wa makarna makran wa hum la yash'urun 50) (27. An-Naml: 50) ke hai ya'ni unhon ne makr kiya aur hum ne bhi is tarah ke unhein maloom na ho saka. Ab toh khud dekh le ke un ke makr ka anjam kya huwa? Hum ne unhein aur un ki kaum ko gharat kar diya. Allah sakht pakad karne wala hai. Bohat qawi hai, poori quwwat-o-taqat wala hai.

Dawat-e-Haq 

Hadhrat Ali bin Abi Talib (R.A) farmate hain Allah ke liye dawat-e-haq hai, is se murad tauheed hai. Muhammad bin Munkadir kehte hain murad La ilaha illallah hai. Phir mushrikeen kafiron ki misal bayan hui ke jaise koi shakhs pani ki taraf hath phailaye hue ho ke uske munh mein khud ba khud pahunch jaye to aisa nahi hone ka. Isi tarah yeh kuffar jinhe pukarte hain aur jinse ummeedein rakhte hain, woh unki ummeedein puri nahi karne ke. 

Aur yeh matlab bhi hai ke jaise koi apni muthiyon mein pani band karle to woh rehne ka nahi. Pas basit qabidh ke ma'ne mein hai. Arabi shair mein bhi qabidh ma'a aya hai, pas jaise pani muthi mein rokne wala aur jaise pani ki taraf hath phailane wala pani se mehroom hai, aise hi yeh mushrik Allah ke siwa doosron ko go pukare lekin rahenge mehroom hi, deen o duniya ka koi faida unhe na pahunchega. Unki pukar be-sood hai.

Azmat-o-Satwat-e-Ilahi 
Allah Ta'ala apni azmat aur saltanat ko bayaan farma raha hai ke har cheez us ke samne past hai aur har ek us ki sarkar mein apni aajizi ka izhaar karti hai. Momin khushi se aur kafir ba-zor us ke samne sajda mein hai. Un ki parchhaiyan subh-o-sham us ke samne jhukti rehti hain. Asal jam'a hai asil ki. Aur aayat mein bhi is ka bayaan hua hai. Farman hai: (Awa lam yarau ila ma khalaqallahu min shai'in yatafaya'u zilaluhu 'anil-yamini wash-shamaili sujjadal lillahi wa hum dakhirun) (16-An-Nahl: 48) Yaani kya unhon ne nahi dekha ke tamam makhlooq Allah ke samne daayein baayein jhuk kar Allah ko sajda karte hain aur apni aajizi ka izhaar karte hain.

Andhera aur Roshni

Allah Ta'ala ke siva koi ma'bud-e-barhaq nahi. Yeh mushrikeen bhi is ke qayil hain ke zameen-o-asman ka Rabb aur mudabbir Allah hi hai. Is ke bawajood doosre awliya ki ibadat karte hain halankah woh sab aajiz bande hain. In ke to kya khud apne bhi nafa nuksan ka inhein koi ikhtiyar nahi, pas yeh aur Allah ke abid yaksan nahi ho sakte. Yeh to andheron mein hain aur banda-e-Rabb noor mein hai. Jitna farq andhe mein aur dekhne wale mein hai, jitna farq andheron aur roshni mein hai utna hi farq in dono mein hai. 

Phir farmata hai ke kya in mushrikeen ke muqarrar karda shareek Allah ke nazdeek kisi cheez ke khaliq hain? Ke in par tameez mushkil ho gayi ke kisi cheez ka khaliq Allah hai? Aur kis cheez ke khaliq in ke ma'bud hain? Halankah aisa nahi, Allah ke mushabeh, is jaisa, is ke barabar ka aur is ki misl ka koi nahi. Woh wazir se, shareek se, aulad se, biwi se pak hai aur in sab se is ki zaat buland-o-bala hai. Yeh to mushrikeen ki poori bewqufi hai ke apne chhote ma'budon ko Allah ka paida kiya hua, is ki mamlook samajhte hue phir bhi in ki pooja-paat mein lage hue hain. Labbaik pukarte hue kehte hain ke ya Allah hum hazir hue tera koi shareek nahi magar woh shareek ke woh khud teri malkiyat mein hai aur jis cheez ka woh malik hai, woh bhi darasal teri hi malkiyat hai. 

Quran ne aur jagah in ka maqoola bayan farmaya hai ke ayat (MA NA'BUDUHUM ILLA LIYUQARRIBONA ILA-LLAHI ZULFA) (39. Az-Zumar: 3) yaani hum to in ki ibadat sirf is lalach mein karte hain ke yeh hamein Allah se qareeb kar dein. In ke is ittiqaad ki rag-e-gardan todte hue irshad-e-Rabbani hua ke is ke paas koi bhi is ki ijazat ke baghair lab nahi hila sakta. Asmanon ke farishte bhi shafa'at is ki ijazat ke baghair kar nahi sakte. Surah Maryam mein farmaya zameen-o-asman ki tamam makhlooq Allah ke samne ghulam ban kar aane wali hai, sab is ki nigah mein aur is ki ginti mein hain aur har ek tanha-tanha is ke samne qayamat ke din hazari dene wala hai. Pas jabke sab ke sab bande aur ghulam hone ki haisiyat mein yaksan hain phir ek ka doosre ki ibadat karna badi himaqat aur khuli be-insaafi nahi to aur kya hai? 

Phir is ne rasoolon ka silsila shuru duniya se jari rakha. Har ek ne logon ko sabaq yeh diya ke Allah ek hi ibadat ke laiq hai. Is ke siva koi aur ibadat ke laiq nahi lekin unhon ne na apne iqrar ka paas kiya na rasoolon ki muttafiqa taleem ka lihaaz kiya, balkah mukhalifat ki, rasoolon ko jhutlaya toh kalma-e-azab un par sadiq aa gaya. Yeh Rabb ka zulm nahi.

Batil besubat hai. Haq-o-batil ke farq, haq ki paidari aur batil ki besubati ki yeh do misalein bayan farmaein. Irshad hua ke Allah Ta'ala badalon se meenah barsata hai, chashmon, daryawon, naliyon waghera ke zariye barsat ka pani behne lagta hai. Kisi mein kam, kisi mein zyada, koi chhoti, koi bari. Yeh dilon ki misal hai aur unke tafawat ki. Koi aasmani ilm bohat zyada hasil karta hai koi kam. Phir pani ki is ro par jhaag tairne lagta hai. Ek misal to yeh hui. Dusri misal sone, chandi, lohe, tanbe ki hai ke use aag mein tapaya jata hai, sone chandi zevar ke liye, loha tanba bartan bhande waghera ke liye, in mein bhi jhaag hote hain. To jaise in dono cheezon ke jhaag mit jate hain, isi tarah batil jo kabhi haq par chha jata hai, aakhir chhat jata hai aur haq nithar aata hai jaise pani nithar kar saaf ho kar reh jata hai aur jaise chandi, sona waghera tapa kar khot se alag kar liye jate hain. Ab sone, chandi, pani waghera se to duniya nafa uthati rehti hai aur un par jo khot aur jhaag aa gaya tha, uska naam-o-nishan bhi nahi rehta. Allah Ta'ala logon ke samjhane ke liye kitni saaf saaf misalein bayan farma raha hai, ke sochein samjhein. Jaise farmaya hai ke hum yeh misalein logon ke samne bayan farmate hain lekin ise ulama khoob samajhte hain. Baz salaf ki samajh mein jo koi misal nahi aati thi to woh rane lagte the kyunke unhe na samajhna ilm se khali logon ka wasf hai. 

Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain pehli misal mein bayan hai un logon ka jin ke dil yaqeen ke sath ilm-e-Ilahi ke hamil hote hain aur baz dil woh bhi hain, jin mein shak baqi reh jata hai, pas shak ke sath ka ilm besood hota hai. Yaqeen poora faida deta hai. Abd se murad shak hai jo kamtar cheez hai, yaqeen kar-e-amad cheez hai, jo baqi rehne wali hai. Jaise zevar jo aag mein tapaya jata hai to khot jal jata hai aur khari cheez reh jati hai, isi tarah Allah ke haan yaqeen maqbool hai shak mardood hai. Pas jis tarah pani reh gaya aur peene waghera ka kaam aaya aur jis tarah sona, chandi asli reh gaya aur uske saz-o-saman bane, isi tarah naik aur khalis aamal amil ko nafa dete hain aur baqi rehte hain. Hidayat-o-haq par jo amil rahe, woh nafa pata hai jaise lohe ki chhri, talwar bagair tapaye ban nahi sakti. Isi tarah batil, shak aur riyakari wale aamal Allah ke haan kar-e-amad nahi ho sakte. Qiyamat ke din batil zaya ho jayega aur ahl-e-haq ko haq nafa dega. 

Surah Baqarah ke shuru mein munafiqon ki do misalein Allah Rabbul Izzat ne bayan farmaein. Ek pani ki, ek aag ki. Surah Nur mein kafiron ki do misalein bayan farmaein. Ek sarab yani reet ki, dusri samundar ki teh ke andheron ki. Reet ka maidan mausam-e-garma mein door se bilkul lehrein leta hua darya ka pani maloom hota hai. Chunacha Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Qiyamat ke din yahudiyon se pucha jayega ke tum kya mangte ho? Kahenge pyase ho rahe hain, pani chahiye to unse kaha jayega ke phir jate kyun nahi ho?

Chanacha Jahannam unhein aisi nazar aaye gi jaise duniya mein retle maidan. Dusri ayat mein farmaya ayat (Wa kazulumatin fil-bahril-lujji) al-akh. Bukhari wa Muslim mein farman-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai ke jis hidayat-o-ilm ke sath Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe mabouth farmaya hai us ki misal us barish ki tarah hai jo zameen par barisi. Zameen ke aik hisse ne to pani ko qubool kiya, ghas chara bakasrat aa gaya. Baaz zameen jazib thi, us ne pani ko rok liya pas Allah ne us se bhi logon ko nafa pahunchaya. Pani un ke peene ke, pilane ke, khet ke kaam aaya aur jo tukda zameen ka sanglakh aur sakht tha na us mein pani thehra na wahan kuch paidaawar hui. Pas yeh us ki misal hai jis ne deen mein samajh hasil ki aur meri baasat se Allah ne use fayda pahunchaya us ne khud ilm sikha dusron ko sikhaya aur misal hai us ki jis ne us ke liye sar bhi na uthaya aur na Allah ki woh hidayat qubool ki jis ke sath main bheja gaya hun. Pas woh sanglakh zameen ki misl hai. Aik aur hadith mein hai meri aur tumhari misal us shakhs ki tarah hai jis ne aag jalai jab aag ne apne aas paas ki cheezein roshan kar din to patange aur parwane waghera keede us mein gir gir kar jaan dene lage woh unhein harchand rokta hai lekin bas phir bhi woh barabar gir rahe hain bilkul yeh misal meri aur tumhari hai ke main tumhari kamar pakad pakad kar tumhe rokta hun aur keh raha hoon ke aag se pare hato lekin tum meri nahi sunte, nahi mante, mujh se chhoot chhoot kar aag mein gire chale jaate ho. Pas hadith mein bhi pani aur aag ki dono misalein aa chuki hain.

Zulqarnain nekon badon ka anjam bayan ho raha hai. Allah Rasul ko manne wale, ahkam ke paband, khabron par yaqeen rakhne wale to nek badla payenge. Zulqarnain (R.H) ne farmaya tha ke zulm karne wale ko hum bhi saza denge aur Allah ke han bhi sakht azab diya jayega aur aimandar aur nek aamal log behtareen badla payenge aur hum bhi un se narmi ki baatein karenge. Aur ayat mein farman-e-Rabi hai: Nekon ke liye nek badla hai aur ziyadti bhi. Phir farmata hai jo log Allah ki baatein nahi mante yeh qayamat ke din aise azabon ko dekhenge ke agar un ke paas sari zameen bhar kar sona ho to woh apne fidyemein dene ke liye taiyar ho jayenge balkhe is jitna aur bhi. Magar qayamat ke roz na fidya hoga, na badla, na iwaz, na muawza. Un se sakht baaz-purs hogi ek ek chhalke aur ek ek dane ka hisab liya jayega hisab mein pure na utre kam to azab hoga. Jahannam un ka thikana hoga jo badtareen jagah hogi.

Ek muwazna irshad hota hai ke ek woh shakhs jo Allah ke kalam ko jo Aap ki janib utra sarasar haq mana ho, sab par iman rakhta ho, ek ko doosre ki tasdeeq karne wala aur muwafiqat karne wala jana ho, sab khabaron ko sach janta ho, sab hukmon ko manta ho, sab buraiyon ko janta ho, Aap ki sachayi ka qayil ho. Aur doosra woh shakhs jo nabina ho, bhalayi ko samajhta hi nahi aur agar samajh bhi le toh manta na ho, na sacha janta ho, yeh dono barabar nahi ho sakte. Jaise farman hai ke dozakhi aur jannati barabar nahi. Jannati khush naseeb hain, yahi farman yahan hai ke yeh dono barabar nahi. Baab yeh hai ke bhali samajh samajh daron hi ki hoti hai.

Munafiq ka nafsiyati tajziya. In buzurgon ki naik sifatain bayan ho rahi hain aur unke bhale anjam ki khabar di ja rahi hai jo aakhirat mein jannat ke malik banenge aur yahan bhi jo naik anjam hain. Woh munafiqon ki tarah nahi hote ke ahd-shikani, ghaddari aur bewafayi karein. Yeh munafiq ki khasalat hai ke wada kar ke tod dein. Jhagdon mein galiyan bakein, baaton mein jhoot boleinge, amanat mein khiyanat karein. Sila-rahmi ka, rishtedaron se suluk karne ka, faqeer muhtaj ko dene ka, bhali baaton ke nibahne ka, jo hukm-e-Ilahi hai yeh iske aamil hain. Rabb ka khauf dil mein rakhte hue farman-e-Ilahi samajh kar nekiyan karte hain, badiyan chhodte hain. Aakhirat ke hisab se darte hain, isisi liye buraiyon se bachte hain, nekiyon ki raghbat karte hain. Etedal ka rasta nahi chhodte. Har haal mein farman-e-Ilahi ka lihaz rakhte hain. Go nafs haram kaamon aur Allah ki nafarmaniyon ki taraf jana chahe lekin yeh ise rok lete hain aur sawab-e-aakhirat yaad dila kar marzi-e-Maula, raza-e-Rabb ke talib ho kar nafarmaniyon se baaz rehte hain. Namaz ki poori hifazat karte hain. Ruku, sajda, qaada, khushu-o-khuzu sharai taur par baja late hain. Jinhe dena Allah ne farmaya hai unhe Allah ki di hui cheezein dete rehte hain. Fuqra, muhtaj, masakeen apne hon ya ghair hon. Unki barkaton se mahroom nahi rehte. Chhupe khule, din raat, waqt bewaqt, barabar rah-e-lillah kharch karte rehte hain. Qabaahat ko ehsan se, burai ko bhalai se, dushmani ko dosti se taal dete hain. Doosra sarkashi kare yeh narmi karte hain. Doosra sar chadhe yeh sar jhuka dete hain. Doosron ke zulm seh lete hain aur khud naik suluk karte hain. Taleem-e-Quran hai aayat (Idfa' billati hiya ahsanu as-sayyi'ah; nahnu a'lamu bima yasifun 23. Al-Mu'minun: 96) bahut acche tareeqe se taal do toh dushman bhi gadha dost ban jayega. Sabr karne wale, sahib-e-naseeb hi is martabe ko pate hain. Aise logon ke liye accha anjam hai. Buruj-o-bala-khane woh accha anjam aur behtareen ghar jannat hai jo hameshgi wali aur paidar hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain jannat ke ek mahal ka naam Adan hai jis mein buruj aur bala-khane hain jis ke paanch hazaar darwaze hain, har darwaze par paanch hazaar farishte hain. Woh mahal مخصوص (makhsoos) hai nabiyon aur siddiqon aur shaheedon ke liye. Zahak (R.H) kahte hain yeh jannat ka shehar hai jis mein ambiya honge shuhada honge aur hidayat ke aimma honge. Unke aas paas aur log honge aur unke ird-gird aur jannatein hain wahan yeh apne aur chahityon ko bhi apne sath dekhenge. Unke bade baap-dadae, unke chote bete pote, unke jode jo bhi imandar aur neko-kaar the unke paas honge aur rahaton se masroor honge jis se unki aankhein thandi rahengi.

Yahan tak ke agar kisi ke amal is darja buland tak pohnchne ke qabil nah bhi hon ge toh Allah Ta'ala un ke darje barha de ga jaise ayat (Wal-lazina amanu wattaba'athum zurriyatuhum bi-imanan al-haqna bihim zurriyatahuma wa ma alatnahum min 'amalihim min shai'in kullu imri-in bima kasaba rahin 21) (52-At-Tur: 21) jin imandaron ki aulad un ki pairwi iman mein karti hai hum unhein bhi un ke sath mila dete hain un ke pas mubarakbad aur salam ke liye har har darwaze se har waqt farishte aate rehte hain yeh bhi Allah ka inaam hai taakh yeh har waqt khush rahein aur bashartein sunte rahein. Nabiyon, Siddiqon, Shaheedon ka paros, farishton ka salam aur Jannat-ul-Firdaus maqam. Musnad ki hadis mein hai jaante bhi ho ke sab se pehle jannat mein kaun jayenge? Logon ne kaha Allah ko ilm hai aur us ke Rasul ﷺ ko farmaya sab se pehle jannati masakeen muhajirin hain jo dunya ki lazzaton se door thay jo takleefon mein mubtala thay jin ke amangein dilon mein hi reh gayin aur qaza aa gayi. Rahmat ke farishton ko Hukm-e-Ilahi hoga ke jao unhein mubarakbad do farishte kahenge Allah hum tere asmanon ke rehne wale teri behtareen makhluq hain kya tu hamein hukm deta hai ke hum ja kar unhein salam karein aur unhein mubarakbad pesh karein Janab-e-Bari jawab dega yeh mere woh bande hain jinhone sirf meri ibadat ki mere sath kisi ko sharik na kiya duniyawi rahaton se mahrum rahe museebaton mein mubtala rahe koi murad poori hone na payi aur yeh sabir-o-shakir rahe ab toh farishte jaldi jaldi basad-e-shauk un ki taraf daurenge idhar udhar ke har ek darwaze se ghusenge aur salam kar ke mubarakbad pesh karenge Tabarani mein hai ke sab se pehle jannat mein jaane wale teen qisam ke log hain fuqra-e-muhajirin jo museebaton mein mubtala rahe, jab unhein hukm mila baja late rahe, unhein zarooratein badshahwon se hoti thin lekin marte dam tak poori na huin. Jannat ko Roz-e-Qayamat Allah Ta'ala apne samne bulayega woh bani sanwari apni tamam nematon aur tazagiyon ke sath hazir hogi us waqt nida hogi ke mere woh bande jo meri rah mein jihad karte the, meri rah mein sataye jaate the, meri rah mein larte bhadte the woh kahan hain? Aao baghair hisab aur azab ke jannat mein chale jao. Us waqt farishte Allah ke samne sajde mein gir parenge aur arz karenge ke Parwardigar hum toh subh-o-sham teri tasbih-o-taqdees mein lage rahe yeh kaun hain jinhein hum par bhi tu ne fazilat ata farmai? Allah Rabb-ul-Izzat farmayega yeh mere woh bande hain jinhone meri rah mein jihad kiya meri rah mein takleefen bardasht keen. Ab toh farishte jaldi kar ke un ke pas har ek darwaze se ja puchenge salam karenge aur mubarakbadiyan pesh karenge ke tumhein tumhare sabr ka badla kitna acha mila.

Hazrat Abu Umamah R.A farmate hain ke Momin Jannat mein apne takht par ba-aram nihayat shan se takiya lagaye baitha hua hoga, khadmon ki qatarein idhar udhar khari hongi jo darwaze wale khadim se farishta ijazat mange ga, woh yakke baad digare pooche ga yahan tak ke Momin se pocha jayega. Momin ijazat dega ke use aane do, yunhi ek dusre ko paigham pohchaye ga aur akhri khadim farishte ko ijazat dega aur darwaza khol dega. Woh aayega aur salam karega aur chala jayega. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Anhadrat ﷺ har saal ke akhir par shuhada ki qabron par aate aur kahte aayat (Salamun ‘alaikum bima sabartum fani‘ma ‘uqbad-dar) (13. Ar-Ra'ad: 24), aur isi tarah Abu Bakr, Umar, Usman bhi R.A (is ki sanad theek nahi).

Ab yahan un bad-naseebon ka zikr ho raha hai jo un ke khilaf khsail rakhte the na Allah ke waadon ka lihaaz karte the na sila rahmi aur ahkaam-e-Ilahi ki pabandi ka khayal rakhte the yeh laanti giroh hai aur bure anjam wala hai. Mulk mein fasaad phailana. Aur yeh dabee hue hote hain tab bhi jhoot wada khilafi aur khayanat karte hain.

Masala-e-Rizq: Allah jis ki rozi mein kushadgi dena chahe qadir hai, jise tang rozi dena chahe qadir hai, yeh sab kuch hikmat o adl se ho raha hai. Kafaron ko duniya par hi sahara ho gaya. Yeh akhirat se ghafil ho gaye, samajhne lage ke yahan rizq ki farawani haqiqi aur bhali cheez hai, halanki darasal yeh mohalat hai aur ahista pakar ki shuruat hai, lekin inhein koi tameez nahi. Mominon ko jo akhirat milne wali hai, uske muqabil toh yeh koi qabil-e-zikr cheez nahi, yeh nihayat na-paidar aur haqeer cheez hai, akhirat bahut bari aur behtar cheez hai. Lekin umuman log duniya ko akhirat par tarjeeh dete hain. Anhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apni kalma ki ungli se ishara kar ke farmaya ke ise koi samundar mein dubo le aur dekhe ke is mein kitna pani aata hai? Jitna yeh pani samundar ke muqabale par hai, utni hi duniya akhirat ke muqabale mein hai (Muslim). Iski poori behas kayi baar guzar chuki ke Allah ko qudrat to hai lekin agar phir bhi yeh tus se mus na hue toh انہیں (unhein) nist-o-nabood kar diya jayega. Hadees mein hai ke Allah ki taraf se Nabi ﷺ par wahi aayi ke unki chahat ke mutabiq main Safa pahaad ko sone ka kar deta hoon, zameen-e-Arab mein meethe daryaaon ki rel-peel kar deta hoon, pahaari zameen ko zaraati zameen se badal deta hoon lekin phir bhi agar yeh iman na laaye toh انہیں (unhein) woh saza doonga jo kisi ko na hoti ho. Agar chahun toh yeh kar dun aur agar chahun toh unke liye tauba aur rehmat ka darwaza khula rehne dun toh Aap ne doosri soorat pasand farmaayi. Sach hai hidayat-o-zalalat Allah ke haath hai woh kisi mojize ke dekhne par mauqoof nahi be-imanoon ke liye nishanaat aur daraave sab be-sood hain jin par kalma-e-azab sadiq ho chuka hai woh tamaam tar nishanaat dekh kar bhi maan kar na dein ge haan azabon ko dekh kar toh poore imandaar ban jayenge lekin woh mehez bekaar cheez hai farmata hai Wa lau anna-na al-ayah, yaani agar hum un par farishte utaarte aur unse murde baatein karte aur har chhipi cheez unke saamne zahir kar dete tab bhi انہیں (unhein) iman naseeb na hota. Haan agar Allah chaahe toh aur baat hai lekin un mein aksar jahil hain. Jo Allah ki taraf jhuke usse madad chaahe uski taraf aajizi kare woh rah-yaafta ho jata hai. Jin ke dilon mein iman jam gaya hai jin ke dil Allah ki taraf jhukte hain, uske zikr se itminan hasil karte hain, raazi khushi ho jaate hain aur fi-waqia zikrullah itminan-e-dil ki cheez bhi hai. Imandaaron aur nek-kaaron ke liye khushi, nek-faali aur aankhon ki thandak hai. Unka anjaam achha hai, yeh mustahiq-e-mubarakbaad hain yeh bhalai ko sameetne wale hain unka lautna behtar hai, unka thikana nek hai. Marwi hai ke Tuba se murad mulk Habash hai aur naam hai jannat ka aur isse murad jannat hai. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain jannat ki jab paidaish ho chuki us waqt janaab-e-bari ne yehi farmaya tha. Kehte hain ke jannat mein ek darakht ka naam bhi Tuba hai ke saari jannat mein uski shaakhon phaili hui hain, har ghar mein uski shaakh maujood hai. Allah Ta'ala ne use apne haath se boya hai, lulu ke daane se paida kiya hai aur bi-hukm-il-Ilahi yeh badha aur phaila hai. Iski jadon se jannati shehad, sharaab, paani aur doodh ki nehrein jaari hoti hain. Ek marfoo hadees mein hai Tuba naami jannat ka ek darakht hai sau saal ke raaste ka. Usi ke khoshon se jannatiyon ke libaas nikalte hain. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke ek shakhs ne kaha Ya Rasulallah ﷺ jis ne Aap ko dekh liya aur Aap par iman laya use mubarak ho? Aap ne farmaya haan use bhi mubarak ho. Aur use dugna mubarak ho jis ne mujhe na dekha aur mujh par iman laya. Ek shakhs ne poocha Tuba kya hai? Aap ne farmaya jannati darakht hai jo sau saal ki raah tak phaila hua hai jannatiyon ke libaas uski shaakhon se nikalte hain.

Bukhari Muslim mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain Jannat mein ek darakht hai ke sawaar ek sau saal tak uske saaye mein chalta rahega lekin woh khatam na hoga aur riwayat mein hai ke chaal bhi tez aur sawari bhi tez chalne wali. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein ayat (Wa Zill-e-Mamdood) ki tafseer mein bhi yehi hai. Aur hadith mein hai sattar ya sau saal uska naam Shajarat-ul-Khuld hai. Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke zikr mein Aap ﷺ ne farmaya hai uski shaakh ke saaye tale ek sau saal tak sawaar chalta rahega aur sau sau sawaar uski ek ek shaakh tale thahar sakte hain. Ismein sone ki tiddiyan hain, uske phal bade bade matkon ke barabar hain (Tirmidhi). Aap ﷺ farmate hain har Jannati ko Tooba ke paas le jayenge aur use ikhtiyar diya jayega ke jis shaakh ko chahe pasand kare. Safed, surkh, zard siyah jo nihayat khoobsurat narm aur achhi hongi. Hazrat Abu Hurairah ؓ farmate hain Tooba ko hukum hoga ke mere bando ke liye behtareen libas waghera. Ibn Jareer ؒ ne is jagah ek ajeeb-o-Ghareeb asar warid kiya hai. Rahib Rahimahullah kehte hain ke Jannat mein ek darakht hai jiska naam Tooba hai jiske saaye tale sawaar sau saal tak chalta rahega lekin rasta khatam na hoga. Uski tarotazgi khule hue chaman ki tarah hai uske patte behtareen aur umda hain uske khushe anbareen hain uske kankar yaqoot hain uski mitti kafoor hai uska gara mushk hai uski jad se sharab, doodh, aur shahad ki nahrein behti hain. Uske neeche Jannatiyon ki majlisien hongi, yeh baithe hue honge jo unke paas farishte oontoniyan lekar aayenge. Jin ki zanjeeren sone ki hongi, jin par yaqoot ke palan honge jin par sona jadaw ho raha hoga jin par reshmi jhoolien hongi. Woh oontoniyan unke samne pesh karenge aur kahenge ke yeh sawariyan tumhein bhizwai gayi hain aur darbar-e-Ilahi mein tumhara bulawa hai, yeh in par sawaar honge, woh parindon ki parwaz se bhi tez raftaar hongi. Jannati ek doosre se mil kar chalenge woh khud bakhud hat jayenge ke kisi ko apne sathi se alag na hona pade yunhi Rahman-o-Raheem Rabb ke paas pahunchenge. Allah Ta'ala apne chehre se parde hata dega yeh apne Rabb ke chehra ko dekhenge aur kahenge dua (Allahumma Antas-Salam wa Ilaikas-Salam wa Haqqan Laka-Jalalu wal-Ikram). Unke jawab mein Allah Ta'ala Rabbul-Izzat farmayega dua (Ana-s-Salam wa Minni-s-Salam) tum par meri rehmat sabit ho chuki aur mohabbat bhi. Mere in bando ko marhaba ho jo bin dekhe mujhse darte rahe meri farmanbardari karte rahe. Jannati kahenge Bari Ta'ala na to humse teri ibadat ka haq ada hua na teri poori qadr hui humein ijazat de ke tere samne sajda karein. Allah farmayega yeh mehnat ki jagah nahi na ibadat ki yeh toh nematon rahaton aur mala maal hone ki jagah hai. Ibadaton ki takleef jati rahi maze lootne ke din aa gaye jo chaho mango, paoge. Tum mein se jo shakhs jo mange main use doonga. Pas yeh mangenge kam se kam sawal wala kahega ke Allah tune duniya mein jo paida kiya tha jismein tere bande haaye waaye kar rahe the.

Main chahta hoon ke shuru duniya se khatam duniya tak duniya mein jitna kuch tha mujhe ata farma. Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga tu ne to kuch na manga apne martabe se bohat kam cheez mangi, acha hum ne di. Meri bakhshis aur deen mein kya kami hai? Phir farmaye ga jin cheezon tak mere in bandon ke khayalat ki rasai bhi nahi woh unhe do, chunache di jayengi yahan tak ke un ki khwahishein puri ho jayengi, in cheezon mein jo unhe yahan milengi tez rau ghore honge, har chaar par yaquti takht hoga, har takht par sone ka ek dera hoga, har dere mein Jannati farsh hoga jin par bari bari ankhon wali do do hoorein hongi jo do do haley pehne hue hongi jin mein Jannat ke tamam rang honge aur tamam khushbuyein. In khaimon ke bahar se un ke chehre aise chamakte honge goya woh bahar baithi hain, un ke pindli ke andar ka guda bahar se nazar aa raha hoga jaise surkh yaqut mein dora piroya hua ho aur woh upar se nazar aa raha ho. Har ek dusri par apni fazilat aisi janti hogi jaisi fazilat suraj ki patthar par, is tarah Jannati ki nigah mein bhi dono aisi hi hongi. Yeh un ke pas jayega aur un se bos-o-kinar mein mashghool ho jayega. Woh dono use dekh kar kahengi Wallah hamare to khayal mein bhi na tha ke Allah tum jaisa khawand humein dega. Ab bi-hukm-e-Ilahi isi tarah saf-bandi ke sath sawariyon par yeh wapas honge aur apni manzilon mein pahunchenge. Dekho to sahi ke Rabb-e-Wahab ne unhe kya kya naimatein ata farma rakhi hain? Wahan buland darja logon mein unche unche bala khano mein jo nare moti ke bane hue honge, jin ke darwaze sone ke honge, jin ke minbar noor ke honge, jin ki chamak suraj se bala-tar hogi. Aala-e-Illiyeen mein un ke mahal honge, yaqut ke bane hue, noorani, jin ke noor se ankhon ki roshni jati rahe lekin Allah Ta'ala un ki ankhein aisi na kar dega. Jo mahal yaqut-e-surkh ke honge un mein sabz reshmi farsh honge aur jo zumurrud-o-yaqut ke honge un ke farsh surkh makhmal ke honge. Jo zumurrud aur sone ke jaraw ke honge un takhton ke paye jawahir ke honge, un par chhatein lulu ki hongi, un ke burj marjan ke honge. Un ke pahunchne se pehle hi Rahmani tohfe wahan pahunch chuke honge, safed yaquti ghore ghilman liye khare honge jin ka saman chandi ka jaraw hoga. Un ke takht par aala reshmi narm-o-dabez farsh biche hue honge, yeh in sawariyon par sawar ho kar be-takalluf Jannat mein jayenge, dekhenge ke un ke gharon ke pas noorani minbaron par farishte un ke istiqbaal ke liye baithe hue hain, woh un ka shandar istiqbaal karenge, mubarakbad denge, musafaha karenge, phir yeh apne gharon mein dakhil honge. Inamat-e-Ilahi wahan mojood payenge, apne mahalon ke pas woh jannatein hari bhari payenge aur jo phali phouli jin mein do chashmey puri rawani se jari honge aur har qism ke jor-dar mewe honge aur khaimon mein pak-daman, bholi bhali parda-nasheen hoorein hongi.

Jab yeh yahan pohch kar rahat-o-aram mein honge us waqt Allah Rabbul-Izzat farmayega, "Mere pyare bando! Tum ne mere wade sachhe paye? Kya tum mere sawabon se khush ho gaye?" 

Woh kahenge, "Allah! Hum khoob khush ho gaye, bahut hi razi razamand hain, dil se razi hain, kali kali khili hui hai to bhi hum se khush rah." 

Allah Ta'ala farmayega, "Agar meri razamandi na hoti to main apne is mehman-khane mein tumhein kaise dakhil hone deta? Apna didar kaise karاتا? Mere farishte tum se musafaha kyun karte? Tum khush raho, ba-aram raho, tumhein mubarak ho, tum phalo-phoolo aur sukh chain uthao, mere yeh inaamat ghatne aur khatam hone wale nahi." 

Us waqt woh kahenge, "Allah hi ki zaat saza-war-e-tareef hai jis ne hum se gham-o-ranj ko door kar diya aur aise maqam par pohchaya ke jahan hamein koi تکلیف, koi mashaqqat nahi, yeh usi ka fazl hai, woh bada hi bakhshne wala aur qadar-daan hai." 

Yeh siyaq ghareeb hai aur yeh asar ajeeb hai, haan is ke ba'az shawahid bhi maujood hain. Chunacha Sahihain mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala us bande se jo sab se akhir mein jannat mein jayega farmayega, "Mang jo mangta jayega," aur Allah Kareem deta jayega yahan tak ke uska sawal poora ho jayega aur payega. Ab uske samne koi khwahish baaki nahi rahegi to ab Allah Ta'ala khud use yaad dilayega ke "Yeh mang, yeh mang," yeh mangega aur payega. Phir Allah Ta'ala farmayega, "Yeh sab main ne tujhe diya aur utna hi aur bhi das martaba ata farmaya." 

Sahih Muslim Sharif ki Qudsi Hadith mein hai ke "Aie mere bando! Tumhare agle pichle insan, jinat sab ek maidan mein khade ho jayein aur mujh se duaein karein aur mangein, main har ek ke tamam sawalaat poore karunga lekin mere mulk mein itni bhi kami na aayegi jitni kisi sui ko samundar mein dubone se samundar ke pani mein aaye," al-khabar. 

Khalid bin Ma'dan kahte hain, "Jannat ke ek darakht ka naam Tuba hai, us mein than hain jin se jannatiyon ke bachhe doodh peete hain, kache gire hue bachhe jannat ki nahron mein hain Qayamat ke qaim hone tak, phir chalis saal ke ban kar apne ma'an baap ke sath jannat mein rahenge."

Allah Ta'ala farmayega, "Agar meri razamandi na hoti to main apne is mehman-khane mein tumhein kaise dakhil hone deta? Apna didar kaise karاتا? Mere farishte tum se musafaha kyun karte? Tum khush raho, ba-aram raho, tumhein mubarak ho, tum phalo-phoolo aur sukh chain uthao, mere yeh inaamat ghatne aur khatam hone wale nahi." 

Us waqt woh kahenge, "Allah hi ki zaat saza-war-e-tareef hai jis ne hum se gham-o-ranj ko door kar diya aur aise maqam par pohchaya ke jahan hamein koi تکلیف, koi mashaqqat nahi, yeh usi ka fazl hai, woh bada hi bakhshne wala aur qadar-daan hai." 

Yeh siyaq ghareeb hai aur yeh asar ajeeb hai, haan is ke ba'az shawahid bhi maujood hain. Chunacha Sahihain mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala us bande se jo sab se akhir mein jannat mein jayega farmayega, "Mang jo mangta jayega," aur Allah Kareem deta jayega yahan tak ke uska sawal poora ho jayega aur payega. Ab uske samne koi khwahish baaki nahi rahegi to ab Allah Ta'ala khud use yaad dilayega ke "Yeh mang, yeh mang," yeh mangega aur payega. Phir Allah Ta'ala farmayega, "Yeh sab main ne tujhe diya aur utna hi aur bhi das martaba ata farmaya." 

Sahih Muslim Sharif ki Qudsi Hadith mein hai ke "Aie mere bando! Tumhare agle pichle insan, jinat sab ek maidan mein khade ho jayein aur mujh se duaein karein aur mangein, main har ek ke tamam sawalaat poore karunga lekin mere mulk mein itni bhi kami na aayegi jitni kisi sui ko samundar mein dubone se samundar ke pani mein aaye," al-khabar. 

Khalid bin Ma'dan kahte hain, "Jannat ke ek darakht ka naam Tuba hai, us mein than hain jin se jannatiyon ke bachhe doodh peete hain, kache gire hue bachhe jannat ki nahron mein hain Qayamat ke qaim hone tak, phir chalis saal ke ban kar apne ma'an baap ke sath jannat mein rahenge."

Mushrikeen ke aitraaz: Mushrikeen ka ek aitraaz bayaan ho raha hai ke agle nabiyon ki tarah yeh hamein hamara kaha hua koi mojiza kyun nahi dikhata? Iski poori behas kayi baar guzar chuki ke Allah ko qudrat to hai lekin agar phir bhi yeh tus se mus na hue toh انہیں (unhein) nist-o-nabood kar diya jayega. Hadees mein hai ke Allah ki taraf se Nabi ﷺ par wahi aayi ke unki chahat ke mutabiq main Safa pahaad ko sone ka kar deta hoon, zameen-e-Arab mein meethe daryaaon ki rel-peel kar deta hoon, pahaari zameen ko zaraati zameen se badal deta hoon lekin phir bhi agar yeh iman na laaye toh انہیں (unhein) woh saza doonga jo kisi ko na hoti ho. Agar chahun toh yeh kar dun aur agar chahun toh unke liye tauba aur rehmat ka darwaza khula rehne dun toh Aap ne doosri soorat pasand farmaayi. Sach hai hidayat-o-zalalat Allah ke haath hai woh kisi mojize ke dekhne par mauqoof nahi be-imanoon ke liye nishanaat aur daraave sab be-sood hain jin par kalma-e-azab sadiq ho chuka hai woh tamaam tar nishanaat dekh kar bhi maan kar na dein ge haan azabon ko dekh kar toh poore imandaar ban jayenge lekin woh mehez bekaar cheez hai farmata hai Wa lau anna-na al-ayah, yaani agar hum un par farishte utaarte aur unse murde baatein karte aur har chhipi cheez unke saamne zahir kar dete tab bhi انہیں (unhein) iman naseeb na hota. Haan agar Allah chaahe toh aur baat hai lekin un mein aksar jahil hain. Jo Allah ki taraf jhuke usse madad chaahe uski taraf aajizi kare woh rah-yaafta ho jata hai. Jin ke dilon mein iman jam gaya hai jin ke dil Allah ki taraf jhukte hain, uske zikr se itminan hasil karte hain, raazi khushi ho jaate hain aur fi-waqia zikrullah itminan-e-dil ki cheez bhi hai. Imandaaron aur nek-kaaron ke liye khushi, nek-faali aur aankhon ki thandak hai. Unka anjaam achha hai, yeh mustahiq-e-mubarakbaad hain yeh bhalai ko sameetne wale hain unka lautna behtar hai, unka thikana nek hai. Marwi hai ke Tuba se murad mulk Habash hai aur naam hai jannat ka aur isse murad jannat hai. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain jannat ki jab paidaish ho chuki us waqt janaab-e-bari ne yehi farmaya tha. Kehte hain ke jannat mein ek darakht ka naam bhi Tuba hai ke saari jannat mein uski shaakhon phaili hui hain, har ghar mein uski shaakh maujood hai. Allah Ta'ala ne use apne haath se boya hai, lulu ke daane se paida kiya hai aur bi-hukm-il-Ilahi yeh badha aur phaila hai. Iski jadon se jannati shehad, sharaab, paani aur doodh ki nehrein jaari hoti hain. Ek marfoo hadees mein hai Tuba naami jannat ka ek darakht hai sau saal ke raaste ka. Usi ke khoshon se jannatiyon ke libaas nikalte hain. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke ek shakhs ne kaha Ya Rasulallah ﷺ jis ne Aap ko dekh liya aur Aap par iman laya use mubarak ho? Aap ne farmaya haan use bhi mubarak ho. Aur use dugna mubarak ho jis ne mujhe na dekha aur mujh par iman laya. Ek shakhs ne poocha Tuba kya hai? Aap ne farmaya jannati darakht hai jo sau saal ki raah tak phaila hua hai jannatiyon ke libaas uski shaakhon se nikalte hain.

Bukhari Muslim mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain Jannat mein ek darakht hai ke sawaar ek sau saal tak uske saaye mein chalta rahega lekin woh khatam na hoga aur riwayat mein hai ke chaal bhi tez aur sawari bhi tez chalne wali. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein ayat (Wa Zill-e-Mamdood) ki tafseer mein bhi yehi hai. Aur hadith mein hai sattar ya sau saal uska naam Shajarat-ul-Khuld hai. Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke zikr mein Aap ﷺ ne farmaya hai uski shaakh ke saaye tale ek sau saal tak sawaar chalta rahega aur sau sau sawaar uski ek ek shaakh tale thahar sakte hain. Ismein sone ki tiddiyan hain, uske phal bade bade matkon ke barabar hain (Tirmidhi). Aap ﷺ farmate hain har Jannati ko Tooba ke paas le jayenge aur use ikhtiyar diya jayega ke jis shaakh ko chahe pasand kare. Safed, surkh, zard siyah jo nihayat khoobsurat narm aur achhi hongi. Hazrat Abu Hurairah ؓ farmate hain Tooba ko hukum hoga ke mere bando ke liye behtareen libas waghera. Ibn Jareer ؒ ne is jagah ek ajeeb-o-Ghareeb asar warid kiya hai. Rahib Rahimahullah kehte hain ke Jannat mein ek darakht hai jiska naam Tooba hai jiske saaye tale sawaar sau saal tak chalta rahega lekin rasta khatam na hoga. Uski tarotazgi khule hue chaman ki tarah hai uske patte behtareen aur umda hain uske khushe anbareen hain uske kankar yaqoot hain uski mitti kafoor hai uska gara mushk hai uski jad se sharab, doodh, aur shahad ki nahrein behti hain. Uske neeche Jannatiyon ki majlisien hongi, yeh baithe hue honge jo unke paas farishte oontoniyan lekar aayenge. Jin ki zanjeeren sone ki hongi, jin par yaqoot ke palan honge jin par sona jadaw ho raha hoga jin par reshmi jhoolien hongi. Woh oontoniyan unke samne pesh karenge aur kahenge ke yeh sawariyan tumhein bhizwai gayi hain aur darbar-e-Ilahi mein tumhara bulawa hai, yeh in par sawaar honge, woh parindon ki parwaz se bhi tez raftaar hongi. Jannati ek doosre se mil kar chalenge woh khud bakhud hat jayenge ke kisi ko apne sathi se alag na hona pade yunhi Rahman-o-Raheem Rabb ke paas pahunchenge. Allah Ta'ala apne chehre se parde hata dega yeh apne Rabb ke chehra ko dekhenge aur kahenge dua (Allahumma Antas-Salam wa Ilaikas-Salam wa Haqqan Laka-Jalalu wal-Ikram). Unke jawab mein Allah Ta'ala Rabbul-Izzat farmayega dua (Ana-s-Salam wa Minni-s-Salam) tum par meri rehmat sabit ho chuki aur mohabbat bhi. Mere in bando ko marhaba ho jo bin dekhe mujhse darte rahe meri farmanbardari karte rahe. Jannati kahenge Bari Ta'ala na to humse teri ibadat ka haq ada hua na teri poori qadr hui humein ijazat de ke tere samne sajda karein. Allah farmayega yeh mehnat ki jagah nahi na ibadat ki yeh toh nematon rahaton aur mala maal hone ki jagah hai. Ibadaton ki takleef jati rahi maze lootne ke din aa gaye jo chaho mango, paoge. Tum mein se jo shakhs jo mange main use doonga. Pas yeh mangenge kam se kam sawal wala kahega ke Allah tune duniya mein jo paida kiya tha jismein tere bande haaye waaye kar rahe the.

Main chahta hoon ke shuru duniya se khatam duniya tak duniya mein jitna kuch tha mujhe ata farma. Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga tu ne to kuch na manga apne martabe se bohat kam cheez mangi, acha hum ne di. Meri bakhshis aur deen mein kya kami hai? Phir farmaye ga jin cheezon tak mere in bandon ke khayalat ki rasai bhi nahi woh unhe do, chunache di jayengi yahan tak ke un ki khwahishein puri ho jayengi, in cheezon mein jo unhe yahan milengi tez rau ghore honge, har chaar par yaquti takht hoga, har takht par sone ka ek dera hoga, har dere mein Jannati farsh hoga jin par bari bari ankhon wali do do hoorein hongi jo do do haley pehne hue hongi jin mein Jannat ke tamam rang honge aur tamam khushbuyein. In khaimon ke bahar se un ke chehre aise chamakte honge goya woh bahar baithi hain, un ke pindli ke andar ka guda bahar se nazar aa raha hoga jaise surkh yaqut mein dora piroya hua ho aur woh upar se nazar aa raha ho. Har ek dusri par apni fazilat aisi janti hogi jaisi fazilat suraj ki patthar par, is tarah Jannati ki nigah mein bhi dono aisi hi hongi. Yeh un ke pas jayega aur un se bos-o-kinar mein mashghool ho jayega. Woh dono use dekh kar kahengi Wallah hamare to khayal mein bhi na tha ke Allah tum jaisa khawand humein dega. Ab bi-hukm-e-Ilahi isi tarah saf-bandi ke sath sawariyon par yeh wapas honge aur apni manzilon mein pahunchenge. Dekho to sahi ke Rabb-e-Wahab ne unhe kya kya naimatein ata farma rakhi hain? Wahan buland darja logon mein unche unche bala khano mein jo nare moti ke bane hue honge, jin ke darwaze sone ke honge, jin ke minbar noor ke honge, jin ki chamak suraj se bala-tar hogi. Aala-e-Illiyeen mein un ke mahal honge, yaqut ke bane hue, noorani, jin ke noor se ankhon ki roshni jati rahe lekin Allah Ta'ala un ki ankhein aisi na kar dega. Jo mahal yaqut-e-surkh ke honge un mein sabz reshmi farsh honge aur jo zumurrud-o-yaqut ke honge un ke farsh surkh makhmal ke honge. Jo zumurrud aur sone ke jaraw ke honge un takhton ke paye jawahir ke honge, un par chhatein lulu ki hongi, un ke burj marjan ke honge. Un ke pahunchne se pehle hi Rahmani tohfe wahan pahunch chuke honge, safed yaquti ghore ghilman liye khare honge jin ka saman chandi ka jaraw hoga. Un ke takht par aala reshmi narm-o-dabez farsh biche hue honge, yeh in sawariyon par sawar ho kar be-takalluf Jannat mein jayenge, dekhenge ke un ke gharon ke pas noorani minbaron par farishte un ke istiqbaal ke liye baithe hue hain, woh un ka shandar istiqbaal karenge, mubarakbad denge, musafaha karenge, phir yeh apne gharon mein dakhil honge. Inamat-e-Ilahi wahan mojood payenge, apne mahalon ke pas woh jannatein hari bhari payenge aur jo phali phouli jin mein do chashmey puri rawani se jari honge aur har qism ke jor-dar mewe honge aur khaimon mein pak-daman, bholi bhali parda-nasheen hoorein hongi.
