Rasoolullah ﷺ ki hausla afzai irshad hota hai ke jaise is ummat ki taraf hum ne tujhe bheja ke tu unhein Kalam-e-Ilahi parh kar sunaye, usi tarah tujh se pehle aur rasoolon ko un agli ummaton ki taraf bheja tha unhon ne bhi paigham-e-Ilahi apni apni ummaton ko pohnchaya magar unhon ne jhutlaya usi tarah tu bhi jhutlaya gaya toh tujhe tang-dil na hona chahiye. Haan un jhutlane walon ko un ka anjam dekhna chahiye jo un se pehle the ke azab-e-Ilahi ne unhein tukre tukre kar diya pas teri takzeeb toh un ki takzeeb se bhi hamare nazdeek zyada napasand hai. Ab yeh dekh lein ke un par kaise azab barste hain? Yahi farman ayat (Tallahi laqad arsalna ila umamin min qablika fazayyana lahumus-shaitanu a'malahum fahuwa waliyyuhumul-yawma walahum azabun alim) (16-An-Nahl: 63) mein aur ayat (Wa laqad kuzzibat rusulum min qablika fasabaru ala ma kuzzibu wa ouzu hatta atahum nasruna wa la mubaddila likalimatil-lahi wa laqad ja'aka min naba'il-mursalin) (6-Al-An'am: 34) mein hai ke dekh le hum ne apne walon ki kis tarah imdad farmayi? Aur unhein kaise ghalib kiya? Teri kaum dekh kar Rahman se kufr kar rahi hai. Woh Allah ke wasf aur naam ko manti hi nahi. Hudaibiya ka sulh-nama likhte waqt is par zid ho gaye ke hum ayat (Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim) nahi likhne denge. Hum nahi jaante ke Rahman aur Rahim kya hai? Poori hadith Bukhari mein mojood hai. Quran mein hai ayat (Quli ud'ul-laha awi ud'ur-rahmana ayyan ma tad'u falahul-asma'ul-husna wa la tajhar bisalatika wa la tukhafit biha wabtaghi baina zalika sabilah) (17-Al-Isra: 110), Allah keh kar use pukaro ya Rahman keh kar jis naam se pukaro woh tamam behtareen namon wala hai. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain Allah ke nazdeek Abdullah aur Abdur-Rahman nihayat pyare naam hain. Farmaya jis se tum kufr kar rahe ho main toh use manta hoon wohi mera parwardigar hai mere bharose usi ke sath hain usi ki janib meri tamam tar tawajjo aur ruju aur dil ka mail is ke siwa koi in baton ka mustahiq nahi.

Quran-e-Hakeem ki Sifaat-e-Jalila: Allah Ta'ala is pak kitab Quran-e-Kareem ki tareefen bayaan farma raha hai. Agar sabiqa kitabon mein kisi kitab ke sath pahad apni jagah se tal jaane wale aur zameen phat jaane wali aur murde jee uthne wale hote, toh yeh Quran jo tamam sabiqa kitabon se badh chadh kar hai, in sab se zyada is baat ka ahal tha. Is mein toh woh mojiz bayani hai ke sare jinnaat-o-insan mil kar bhi is jaisi ek surat na bana kar la sake. Yeh mushrikeen iske bhi munkir hain toh mamla supurd-e-Rabb karo. Woh Malik-e-Kul hai, tamam kamon ka marja wahi hai, woh jo chahta hai ho jata hai, jo nahi chahta hargiz nahi hota. Uske bhatkaye huwe ki rahbar aur uske rah dikhaye huwe ki gumrahi kisi ke bas mein nahi. Yeh yaad rahe ke Quran ka itlaq agli ilhami kitabon par bhi hota hai isliye ke woh sab se mushtaq hai. Musnad mein hai, Hazrat Dawood (A.S) par Quran is qadr asan kar diya gaya tha ke unke hukum se sawari kasi jati, uske tayar hone se pehle hi woh Quran ko khatam kar lete, siwa apne hath ki kamayi ke woh aur kuch na khate the. Pas murad yahan Quran se Zaboor hai. 

Kya imandaar ab tak is se mayus nahi huwe ke tamam makhlooq iman nahi layegi? Kya woh Mashiyyat-e-Ilahi ke khilaf kuch kar sakte hain? Rabb ki yeh mansha hi nahi, agar hoti toh ro-e-zameen ke log musalman ho jate. Bhala is Quran ke baad kis mojize ki zaroorat duniya ko reh gayi? Is se behtar wazeh, is se saf, is se zyada dilon mein ghar karne wala aur kaun sa kalam hoga? Ise toh agar bade se bade pahad par utara jata toh woh bhi Khashyat-e-Ilahi se chakna choor ho jata. 

Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain, har Nabi ko aisi cheez mili ke log us par iman layein. Meri aisi cheez Allah ki yeh wahi hai, pas mujhe ummeed hai ke sab Nabiyon se zyada tabedaron wala main ho jaunga. Matlab yeh hai ke Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) ke mojize unke sath hi chale gaye aur mera yeh mojiza jeeta jagta rehti duniya tak rahega, na iske ajaibat khatam hon, na yeh kasrat-e-tilawat se purana ho, na is se ulama ka pait bhar jaye. Yeh fazl hai, dil lagi nahi. Jo sarkash ise chhod dega, Allah ise tod dega. Jo iske siwa aur mein hidayat talash karega, ise Allah gumrah kar dega. 

Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) farmate hain ke kafiron ne An-Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ se kaha: Agar aap yahan ke pahad yahan se hata dein aur yahan ki zameen zarat ke qabil ho jaye aur jis tarah Sulaiman (A.S) zameen ki khudayi hawa se karate the, aap bhi kara dijiye ya jis tarah Hazrat Isa (A.S) murdon ko zinda kar dete the, aap bhi kar dijiye. Is par yeh ayat utri. 

Qatadah (R.H) farmate hain, matlab yeh hai ke agar kisi Quran ke sath yeh umoor zahir hote toh is tumhare Quran ke sath bhi hote. Sab kuch Allah ke ikhtiyar mein hai lekin woh aisa nahi karta taake tum sab ko aazma le, apne ikhtiyar se iman lao ya na lao. Kya iman wale nahi jaante? Ya "layasa" ke badle dusri jagah "yatabayyan" bhi hai, imandaar unki hidayat se mayus ho chuke the.

Haan Allah Ta'ala ke ikhtiyar mein kisi ka bas nahi, woh agar chahe tamam makhlooq ko hidayat par khada kar de. Yeh kuffar barabar dekh rahe hain ke unke jhutlane ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala ke azab barabar un par barste rehte hain ya unke aas paas aa jate hain, phir bhi yeh nasehhat hasil nahi karte? Jaise farman hai: Ayat (Wa laqad ahlakna ma hawlakum minal-qura wa sarrafnal-ayati la'allahum yarji'oon) (46. Al-Ahqaf: 27) Yani hum ne tumhare aas paas ki bahut si bastiyon ko unki bad-kardariyon ki wajah se gharat-o-barbaad kar diya aur tarah tarah se apni nishaniyan zahir farmayeen ke log buraiyon se baaz rahein. Aur aayat mein hai: Ayat (Awalam yaraw anna na'til-arda nanqusuha min atrafiha, wallahu yahkumu la mu'aqqiba lihukmihi, wa huwa sari'ul-hisab) (13. Ar-Ra'd: 41) Kya woh nahi dekh rahe ke hum zameen ko ghatate chale aa rahe hain, kya ab bhi apna hi ghalba mante chale jayenge? 

Tahl ka fa'il qari'ah hai, yehi zahir aur mutabiq-e-rawani-e-ibarat hai, lekin Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke qari'ah pahunche, yani chhota sa lashkar-e-islami ya to khud unke shehar ke kareeb utar pade yani Muhammad (ﷺ) yahan tak ke wada-e-rabbaani aa pahunche, isse murad Fath-e-Makkah hai. Aap hi se marwi hai ke qari'ah se murad asmaani azab hai aur aas paas utarne se murad An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ka apne lashkaroon samait unki hudood mein pahunch jana hai aur unse jihad karna hai. In sab ka qoul hai ke yahan wada-e-Ilahi se murad Fath-e-Makkah hai. Lekin Hasan Basri (Rahimahullah) farmate hain isse murad Qiyamat ka din hai. 

Allah Ta'ala ka wada apne rasoolon ki nusrat-o-imdad ka hai, woh kabhi talne wala nahi, unhe aur unke tab'adaron ko zaroor bulandi naseeb hogi. Jaise farman hai: Ayat (Wa la tahsannallaha mukhlifa wa'dahu rusulahu, inna Allaha 'Azizun Zu-Intiqam). Yeh ghalat guman hargiz na karo ke Allah Ta'ala apne rasoolon se wada-khilafi kare. Allah Ta'ala ghalib hai aur badla lene wala hai.

Sachai ka mazak urana aaj bhi jari hai. Allah Ta'ala apne Rasool ﷺ ko tasalli deta hai ki aap apni kaum ke ghalat rawaiye se ranj-o-fikr na karein, aap se pehle ke paighambaron ka bhi yunhi mazak uraya gaya tha. Maine in kafiron ko bhi kuch dair to dheel di thi, aakhir-ish buri tarah pakr liya tha aur naam-o-nishan tak mita diya tha. Tujhe maloom hai ki kis kaifiyat se mere azaab un par aaye? Aur un ka anjam kaisa kuch hua? Jaise farman hai: Bahut si bastiyan hain jo zulm ke bawajood ek arsa se duniya mein mohlat liye rahein lekin aakhir-ish apni bad-aamaliyon ki padash mein azaabon ka shikar huin. 

Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya hai: Allah Ta'ala zalim ko dheel deta hai, phir jab pakarta hai toh woh hairan reh jata hai. Phir aap ne aayat ki tilawat ki: 
(Wa kazalika akhzu rabbika iza akhazal-qura wa hiya zalimatun inna akhzahu aleemun shadeed) (Surah Hud: 102).

Aalam-e-Khair-o-Sharr, Allah Ta'ala har insan ke aamal ka muhafiz hai, har ek ke aamal ko janta hai, har nafs par nigehban hai, har aamil ke khair-o-sharr ke ilm se ba-khabar hai. Koi cheez us se poshida nahi, koi kaam us ki be-khabari mein nahi hota. Har halat ka use ilm hai, har amal par woh mojood hai, har patte ke jhadne ka use ilm hai, har jandar ki rozi Allah ke zimme hai, har ek ke thikane ka use ilm hai, har baat us ki Kitab mein likhi hui hai. Zahir-o-batin har baat ko woh janta hai, tum jahan ho wahan Allah tumhare sath hai, tumhare aamal dekh raha hai. In sifton wala Allah kya tumhare in jhoote maboodon jaisa hai? Jo na sunein, na dekhein, na apne liye kisi cheez ke malik, na kisi aur ke nafa-nuqsaan ka unhein ikhtiyar. Iss jawab ko hazf kar diya kyunki dalalat-e-kalam mojood hai. Aur woh farman-e-Ilahi aayat (Wa ja'alu lillahi shuraka'al-jinna wa khalaqahum wa kharaqu lahu baniwna wa banatin bi-ghayri 'ilmin subhanahu wa ta'ala 'amma yasifun) (Surah Al-An'am: 100) hai.

Unhon ne Allah ke sath auron ko sharik thehraya aur un ki ibadat karne lage, tum zara un ke naam to batao, un ke halat to bayan karo taake duniya jaan le ke woh mahz be-haqeeqat hain. Kya tum zameen ki jin cheezon ki khabar Allah ko de rahe ho jinhein woh nahi janta, yani jin ka wajood hi nahi? Is liye ke agar wajood hota to ilm-e-Ilahi se bahar na hota, kyunki us par koi makhfi se makhfi cheez bhi haqiqatan makhfi nahi, ya sirf atkal-pachu baatein bana rahe ho? Fazool gap maar rahe ho, tum ne aap un ke naam ghad liye, tum ne hi unhein nafa-nuqsaan ka malik qarar diya aur tum ne hi un ki pooja-paath shuru kar di. Yahi tumhare bade karte rahe. Na to tumhare hath mein koi rabbani daleel hai, na aur koi thos daleel, yeh to sirf wahm-parasti aur khwahish-parwari hai.

Adawat Allah ki taraf se nazil ho chuki hai. Kuffar ka makr unhein bhale rang mein dikhai de raha hai, woh apne kufr par aur apne shirk par hi naaz kar rahe hain, din raat isi mein mashghool hain aur isi ki taraf auron ko bula rahe hain. Jaise farmaya aayat (Wa qayyadna lahum qurana'an fa zayyanu lahum ma baina aydihim wa ma khalfahum wa haqq 'alayhimu-qawlu fi umamin qad khalat min qablihim minal-jinni wal-insi innahum kanu khasirin) (Surah Fussilat: 25). Un ke shaitanon ne un ki be-dhangiyan un ke samne dilkash bana di hain, yeh rah-e-Allah se, tariqa-e-huda se rok diye gaye hain. Ek qirat is ki (saddaw) bhi hai, yani unhein is tarah acha jaan kar phir auron ko is mein phansna shuru kar diya aur rah-e-Rasool se logon ko rokne lage.

Rabb ke gumrah kiye hue logon ko kaun rah dikha sakega? Jaise farmaya aayat (Wa man yuridillah fitnatan fa lan tamliku lahu minallahi shai'an), jise Allah fitne mein dalna chahe to us ke liye Allah ke yahan kuch bhi to ikhtiyar nahi.

Aur ayat mein hai: "Go tu un ki hidayat ka lalchi ho lekin Allah un gumrahon ko rah dikhana nahi chahta, phir kaun hai jo un ki madad kare."

Kafir Maut Mangenge: Kafir ki saza aur naik-karon ki jaza ka zikr ho raha hai. Kafir-on ka kufr-o-shirq bayan farma kar un ki saza bayan farmai ke woh momino ke hathon qatl-o-gharat honge, is ke sath hi aakhirat ke sakht-tar azabon mein giraftar honge jo is duniya ki saza se darja badtar hain. Mula'ana karne wale miyan-biwi se Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya tha ke duniya ka azaab aakhirat ke azaab se bahut hi halka hai. Yahan ka azaab fani wahan ka baaki aur us aag ka azaab jo yahan ki aag se sattar hisse zyada tez hai, phir qaid woh jo tasawwur mein bhi na aa sake. Jaise farman hai ayat (Fa yauma'izin la yu'azzibu azabahu ahad) (89. Al-Fajr: 25), aaj is azaab jaise na kisi ka azaab na is jaisi kisi ki qaid-o-band. Farman hai ayat (Wa a'tadna liman kazzaba bis-sa'ati sa'ira) al-kh, Qiyamat ke munkiro ke liye hum ne aag ka azaab tayyar kar rakha hai, door se hi unhe dekhte hi shor-o-ghal shuru kar degi, wahan ke tang-o-tareek makanat mein jab ye jakde hue dale jayenge toh haye-waye karte hue maut mangne lagenge. Ek hi maut kya mangte ho bahut si mautein mango. Ab batao ke ye theek hai ya jannat-e-khuld theek hai jis ka wada parhizgaron se kiya gaya hai ke woh un ka badla hai aur un ka hamesha rehne ka thikana. 

Phir neko ka anjam bayan farmata hai ke un se jin jannaton ka wada hai us ki ek sifat toh yeh hai ke us ke charon taraf nehrein jari hain jahan chahein pani le jayen, pani na bigadne wala, phir doodh ki nehrein hain aur doodh bhi aisa jis ka maza kabhi na bigare, aur sharab ki nehrein hain jis mein sirf lazzat hai, na bad-mazgi, na behuda nasha, aur saaf shehad ki nehrein hain aur har qism ke phal hain aur sath hi Rab ki rahmat, Malik-e-Ma'rifat. Us ke phal hameshgi wale, us ki khane peene ki cheezein kabhi fana hone wali nahi. 

Jab An-Hazrat ﷺ ne kusoof ki namaz padhi thi toh Sahaba ؓ ne pucha ke Huzoor ﷺ hum ne aap ko dekha ke aap pichle paon peeche ko hatne lage. Aap ne farmaya han maine jannat ko dekha tha aur chaha tha ke ek khosha tod loon agar le leta toh rehti duniya tak woh rehta aur tum khate rehte. Abu Ya'la mein hai ke ek din Zuhr ki namaz mein hum An-Hazrat ﷺ ke sath the ke aap nagah aage bade aur hum bhi bade, phir hum ne dekha ke aap ne goya koi cheez lene ka irada kiya phir aap peeche hat aye. Namaz ke khatma ke baad Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab ؓ ne دریافت kiya ke Ya Rasulullah ﷺ aaj toh hum ne aap ko aisa kaam karte hue dekha ke aaj se pehle kabhi nahi dekha tha. Aap ne farmaya han mere samne jannat pesh ki gai jo tar-o-tazgi se mehak rahi thi, maine chaha ke is mein se ek khosha angoor ka tod laaun lekin mere aur us ke darmiyan aad kar di gai, agar main ise tod lata toh tamam duniya poori duniya tak ise khati rehti aur phir bhi zara sa bhi kam na hota.

Us ne kaha achcha to jo khayega piyega use peshab pakhane ki bhi haajat lagegi phir jannat mein gandagi kaisi? Aap ne farmaya nahi balki pasine ke raste sab hazm ho jayega aur woh pasina mushk-bo hoga. Shad-an-o-farhan log jo log us se pehle kitab diye gaye hain aur woh us ke amil hain woh toh tujh par is Quran ke utarne se shad-an-o-farhan ho rahe hain kyunki khud un ki kitabon mein is ki basharat aur is ki sadaqat maujud hai. Jaise ayat (Al-lazina atainahul-kitaba yat-lunaHu haqqa tilawatihi) (2-Al-Baqarah: 121) mein hai ke agli kitabon ko achchi taur se parhne is akhri kitab par bhi iman laate hain. An-Hazrat ﷺ ki risalat ki khabar hai aur woh us wade ko poora dekh kar khushi se maan lete hain. Allah Ta'ala is se pak hai ke us ke wade ghalat niklein us ke farman sahi sabit na hon pas woh shad-man hote hue Allah ke samne sajde mein gir parte hain. Haan un jamaton mein aise bhi hain jo is ki baaz baaton ko nahi mante, gharz baaz Ahl-e-Kitab musalman hain baaz nahi, toh aae Nabi ailan kar de ke mujhe sirf Allah wahid ki ibadat ka hukm mila huwa hai ke doosre ki shirakat ke baghair sirf isi ki ibadat us ki hi tawhid ke sath karun yahi hukm mujh se pehle ke tamam nabiyon aur rasoolon ko mila tha, isi rah ki taraf isi Elahi ibadat ki taraf mein tamam duniya ko dawat deta hun. Isi Allah ki taraf sab ko bulata hoon aur isi Allah ki taraf mera lotna hai. Jis tarah hum ne tum se pehle nabi bheje un par apni kitabein nazil farmaein usi tarah yeh Quran jo muhkam aur mazboot hai arabi zaban mein jo teri aur teri kaum ki zaban hai is Quran ko hum ne tujh par nazil farmaya. Yeh bhi tujh par khas ehsan hai ke is wazeh izhar mufassal aur muhkam kitab ke sath tujhe hum ne nawaza ke na is ke aage se batil aa sake na is ke peechhe se aa kar is mein mil sake yeh Hakim-o-Hamid Allah ki taraf se utri hai. Aae Nabi ﷺ tere pas ilhami ilm asmani wahi aa chuki hai ab bhi agar to ne un ki khwahish ki matahati ki toh yaad rakh ke Allah ke azabon se tujhe koi bhi na bacha sakega. Na koi teri himayat par khara hoga. Sunnat-e-Nabawiyyah aur Tariqa-e-Muhammadiyyah ke ilm ke baad jo gumrahi walon ke raston ko ikhtiyar karein un ulama ke liye is ayat mein zabardast wa'eed hai.

Har kaam ka waqt muqarrar hai irshad hai ke jaise aap bawajood insan hone ke Rasoolullah hain. Aise hi aap se pehle ke tamam rasool bhi insan hi thay, khana khatay thay, bazaron mein chalte phirte thay biwi, bachon wale thay. Aur aayat mein hai ke aye Ashraf-ur-Rusul aap logon se keh dijiye ke aayat (Innama ana basharun mislukum yuha ilayya) mein bhi tum jaisa hi ek insan hoon meri taraf wahi-e-Ilahi ki jati hai. Bukhari Muslim ki hadith mein hai. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain ke main nafli rozay rakhta bhi hoon aur nahi bhi rakhta raton ko tahajjud bhi parhta hoon aur sota bhi hoon gosht bhi khata hoon aur aurton se bhi milta hoon jo shakhs mere tareeqe se munh mor le woh mera nahi. Musnad Ahmad mein aap ka farman hai ke chaar cheezein tamam ambiya ka tareeqa rahin khushboo lagana, nikah karna, miswak karna aur mehndi, phir farmata hai ke mojze zahir karna kisi nabi ke bas ki baat nahi. Yeh Allah Azzawajal ke qabzay ki cheez hai woh jo chahta hai karta hai, jo irada karta hai hukm deta hai har ek baat muqarrarah waqt aur maloom muddat kitab mein likhi hui hai, har shay ki ek miqdar moayyan hai. Kya tumhein maloom nahi ke zameen o aasman ki tamam cheezon ka Allah ko ilm hai sab kuch kitab mein likha mojood hai yeh to Allah par bahut hi aasan hai. Har kitab ki jo aasman se utri hai uski ek ajal hai aur ek muddat muqarrar hai un mein se jise chahta hai mansookh kar deta hai jise chahta hai baqi rakhta hai pas is Quran se jo usne apne Rasool Salawatullahi wa Salamuhu Alaihi par nazil farmaya hai tamam agli kitabein mansookh ho gain. Allah Ta'ala jo chahe mitaye jo chahe baqi rakhe saal bhar ke umoor muqarrar kar diye lekin ikhtiyar se bahar nahi jo chaha baqi rakha jo chaha badal diya. Siwaye shiqawat, sa'adat, hayat-o-mamat ke. Ke un se faraghat hasil kar li gayi hai un mein taghayyur nahi hona. Mansoor kehte hain maine Hazrat Mujahid ؒ se poocha ke hum mein se kisi ka yeh dua karna kaisa hai ke Ilahi agar mera naam nekton mein hai to baqi rakh aur agar badon mein hai to ise hata de aur nekton mein kar de. Aap ne farmaya yeh to achhi dua hai saal bhar ke baad phir mulaqat hui ya kuch zyada arsa guzar gaya tha to maine un se yahi baat دریافت ki aap ne aayat (Inna anzalnahu fi Lailatin Mubarakatin) se do aayaton ki tilawat ki aur farmaya Lailatul Qadr mein saal bhar ki roziyan, takleifein muqarrar ho jati hain. Phir jo Allah chahe muqaddam moakhkhar karta hai, haan sa'adat shiqawat ki kitab nahi badalti. Hazrat Shaqiq bin Salmah aksar yeh dua kiya karte thay Aaye Allah agar tune humein badbakhton mein likha hai to ise mita de aur hamari ginti nekton mein likh le aur agar tune humein nek logon mein likha hai to ise baqi rakh tu jo chahe mita de aur jo chahe baqi rakh asl kitab tere hi paas hai.

Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A Baitullah Sharif ka tawaf karte hue rote rote yeh dua padha karte thay: "Aye Allah! Agar tu ne mujh par burai aur gunah likh rakhe hain toh unhein mita de, tu jise chahe mitata hai aur baaqi rakhta hai, Umm-ul-Kitab tere pas hi hai, toh ise saadat aur rahmat kar de." Hazrat Ibn Masood R.A bhi yahi dua kiya karte thay. Ka'ab R.H ne Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar R.A se kaha ke agar ek ayat Kitabullah mein na hoti toh main Qiyamat tak jo umoor hone wale hain sab aap ko bata deta. Pucha ke woh kaun si ayat hai? Aap ne usi ayat ki tilawat farmayi. 

In tamam aqwal ka matlab yeh hai ke taqdeer ki ulat-pult Allah ke ikhtiyar ki cheez hai. Chunancha Musnad Ahmad ki ek hadis mein hai ke ba'az gunahon ki wajah se insan apni rozi se mahroom kar diya jata hai aur taqdeer ko dua ke siva koi cheez badal nahi sakti aur umr ki ziyadti karne wali bajuz neki ke koi cheez nahi. Nasai aur Ibn Majah mein bhi yeh hadis hai. Aur sahih hadis mein hai ke silah-rehmi umr badhati hai. Aur hadis mein hai ke dua aur qaza donon ki mid-bhed aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan hoti hai. 

Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain Allah Azzawajal ke pas Lauh-e-Mahfuz hai jo paanch sau saal ke raste ki cheez hai, safed moti ki hai, yaqoot ke do pathon ke darmiyan. Tresath baar Allah Ta'ala us par tawajju farmata hai; jo chahta hai mitata hai, jo chahta hai barqarar rakhta hai, Umm-ul-Kitab usi ke pas hai. 

Huzoor ﷺ ka irshad hai ke raat ki teen saatein baaqi rehne par daftar khola jata hai, pehli saat mein is daftar par nazar dali jati hai jise us ke siva koi aur nahi dekhta, pas jo chahta hai mitata hai jo chahta hai barqarar rakhta hai. 

Kalbi farmate hain rozi ko badhana-ghatana, umr ko badhana-ghatana is se murad hai. Un se pucha gaya ke aap se yeh baat kis ne bayan ki? Farmaya: Abu Saleh ne, un se Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah bin Ribab ne, un se Nabi ﷺ ne. Phir un se is ayat ki baabat sawal hua toh jawab diya ke Jumerat ke din sab baatein likhi jati hain, un mein se jo baatein jaza-saza se khali hon nikal di jati hain jaise tera yeh قول ke "main ne khaya, main ne piya, main ne aya, main gaya" waghera jo sachi baatein hain aur sawab-azab ki cheezein nahi, aur baaqi jo sawab-azab ki cheezein hain woh rakh li jati hain. 

Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A ka qaul hai ke jo kitabein hain ek mein kami ziyadti hoti hai aur Allah ke pas jo asl kitab hai wohi hai. Farmate hain murad is se woh shakhs hai jo ek zamane tak toh Allah ki itaat mein laga rehta hai phir masiyat mein lag jata hai aur usi par marta hai, pas uski neki mahw ho jati hai aur jis ke liye sabit rehti hai yeh woh hai jo us waqt toh nafarmaniyon mein mashghool hai lekin Allah ki taraf se us ke liye farman-bardari pehle se muqarrar ho chuki hai, pas aakhri waqt woh khair par lag jata hai aur taa't-e-Ilahi mein marta hai, yeh hai jis ke liye sabit rehti hai.

Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ki jise chahe bakhshe jise chahe na bakhshe. Ibn Abbas ka qaul hai jo chahta hai mansookh karta hai jo chahta hai tabdeel nahi karta nasikh ka ikhtiyar usi ke paas hai aur udo-badal bhi. Baqol Qatadah yeh ayat misl-e-ayat (ma nansakh al-kh.) ke hai yaani jo chahe mansookh kar de jo chahe baqi aur jari rakhe. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain jab is se pehle ki ayat utri ki koi Rasul baghair Allah ke farman ke koi mojiza nahi dikha sakta to Quraish ke kafiron ne kaha phir Muhammad (ﷺ) bilkul be-bas hain kaam se to faraghat hasil ho chuki hai pas unhen darane ke liye yeh ayat utri ki hum jo chahein tajdeed kar dein har Ramadan mein tajdeed hoti hai phir Allah jo chahta hai mita deta hai jo chahta hai sabit rakhta hai rozi bhi takleef bhi deta hai aur taqseem bhi. Hasan Basri farmate hain jis ki ajal aa jaye chal basta hai na aayi ho reh jata hai yahan tak ki apne din poore kar le. Ibn Jarir (R.H) isi qaul ko pasand farmate hain. Halal haram us ke paas hai kitab ka khulasa aur jad usi ke hath hai kitab khud Rabb-ul-Alamin ke paas hi hai. Ibn Abbas (R.H) ne Ka'b se Umm-ul-Kitab ki babat daryaft kiya to aap ne jawab diya ki Allah ne makhlooq ko aur makhlooq ke aamal ko jaan liya. Phir kaha ki kitab ki soorat mein ho jaye ho gaya. Ibn Abbas (R.H) farmate hain Umm-ul-Kitab se murad zikr hai.

Kya woh nahi dekhte ke hum zameen ko tere qabze mein dete aa rahe hain ? Kya woh nahi dekhte ke abad aur aali shan mahal khandandar aur veerane bante ja rahe hain ? Al-ardu tahya iza ma asha alimuha, mata yumut alimun minha yumut tarafun.
Kal-ardu tahya iza mal-ghaithu halla biha, wa in aba arifu ikna faha at-talaf.

Kafaron ke sharmnak karnamey. Agle kafaron ne bhi apne nabiyon ke sath makr kiya, unhe nikalna chaha, Allah ne unke makr ka badla liya. Anjam-e-kar parhizgaron ka hi bhala hua. Is se pehle aap ke zamane ke kafaron ki kartani bayan ho chuki hai ke woh aap ko qaid karne ya qatal karne ya dais se nikal dene ka mashwara kar rahe the, woh ghat mein the aur Allah unki ghat mein tha. Bhala Allah se zyada achhi poshida tadbeer kis ki ho sakti hai? Unke makr par hum ne bhi yahi kiya aur yeh be-khabar rahe. Dekh le ke unke makr ka anjam kya hua? Yahi ke hum ne unhe gharat kar diya aur unki sari kaum ko barbad kar diya, unke zulm ki shahadat dene wale unki ghair-abad bastiyon ke khandrat abhi maujud hain. Har ek ke har ek amal se Allah Ta'ala ba-khabar hai, poshida amal, dil ke khauf us par zahir hain, har amil ko us ke aamal ka badla dega. Al-Kuffar ki dusri qirat Al-Kafir bhi hai. In kafaron ko abhi malum ho jaye ga ke anjam-e-kar kis ka achha rehta hai, unka ya musalmanon ka? Alhamdulillah, Allah Ta'ala ne hamesha haq walon ko hi ghalib rakha hai, anjam ke aitbar se yahi achhe rehte hain, duniya akhirat unhi ki sanwarti hai.

Risalat ke munkar kafir tujhe jhutla rahe hain. Teri risalat ke munkar hain. Tu gham na kar keh diya kar ke Allah ki shahadat kafi hai. Teri naboot ka woh khud gawah hai, meri tabligh par, tumhari takzeeb par, woh shahid hai. Meri sachai, tumhari takzeeb ko woh dekh raha hai. Ilm-e-Kitab jis ke paas hai is se murad Abdullah bin Salam hain R.A. Yeh qaul Hazrat Mujahid R.H waghairah ka hai lekin bahut ghareeb qaul hai is liye ke yeh ayat Makkah Shareef mein utri hai aur Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam R.A toh hijrat ke baad Madine mein مسلمان hue hain. Is se zyada zahir Ibn Abbas R.A ka qaul hai ki Yahood-o-Nasara ke haq go aalim murad hain haan in mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam bhi hain, Hazrat Salman aur Hazrat Tamim Dari waghairah R.A bhi. Hazrat Mujahid R.H se ek riwayat mein marwi hai ki is se murad bhi khud Allah Ta'ala hai. Hazrat Saeed R.H is se inkari the ke is se murad Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam liye jayen kyunki yeh ayat Makkiyah hai aur ayat ko "min 'indihi" padhte the. Yahi qiraat Mujahid aur Hasan Basri se bhi marwi hai. Ek marfoo hadees mein bhi qiraat hai lekin woh hadees sabit nahi. Sahi baat yahi hai ki yeh ism-e-jins hai har woh aalim jo agli kitab ka ilm hai is mein dakhil hai un ki kitabon mein An-Hazrat ﷺ ki sifat aur aap ki basharat mojood thi. Un ke nabiyon ne aap ki babat paishgoi kar di thi. Jaise farman-e-Rab-e-Zishan hai ayat (Wa rahmati wasi'at kulla shai') yani meri rehmat ne tamam cheezon ko gher rakha hai main ise un logon ke naam likh dunga jo muttaqi hain, zakat ke ada karne wale hain, hamari ayon par iman rakhne wale hain, Rasool Nabi ﷺ ki itaat karne wale hain, jiska zikr apni kitab Taurat-o-Injeel mein mojood pate hain aur ayat mein hai ki kya yeh baat bhi un ke liye kafi nahi ke is ke haq hone ka ilm ulama-e-Bani Israel ko bhi hai. Ek bahut hi ghareeb hadees mein hai ki Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam R.A ne ulama-e-Yahood se kaha ki mera irada hai ki apne baap Ibrahim-o-Ismail ki masjid mein ja kar eid manayen Makkah pahunche An-Hazrat ﷺ yahin the yeh log jab hajj se lote toh aap se mulaqat hui us waqt aap ek majlis mein tashreef farma the aur log bhi aap ke paas the yeh bhi ma'a apne sathi ke khade ho gaye ﷺ ne un ki taraf dekh kar pucha ki aap hi Abdullah bin Salam hain kaha haan farmaya qareeb aao jab qareeb gaye toh aap ne farmaya kya tum mera zikr Taurat mein nahi pate? Unhon ne kaha aap Allah Ta'ala ke ausaf mere samne bayan farmaiye usi waqt Hazrat Jibreel A.S aaye aap ke samne khade ho gaye aur hukum diya ki kaho ayat (Qul huwallahu ahad) aap ne poori surat padh sunai. Ibn Salam ne usi waqt kalma padh liya, musalman ho gaye, Madine wapas chale aaye lekin apne islam ko chupaye rahe. Jab Huzoor ﷺ hijrat kar ke Madine pahuche us waqt aap khajoor ke ek darakht par chadhe hue khajoor utar rahe the jab aap ko khabar pahunchi usi waqt darakht se kood pade. Maan kehne lagin ki agar Hazrat Musa A.S bhi aa jate toh tum darakht se na koodte. Kya baat hai?

Jawab diya ke Amma ji Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ki nubuwwat se bhi zyada khushi mujhe Khatam-ul-Mursaleen (ﷺ) ki yahan tashreef awari se hui hai.
